CREATE    VIEW PEGGINGIV AS SELECT   'PEGGING' AS USERID,  PEGGING.ITEMNMBR,  PEGGING.LOCNCODE,  PEGGING.DUEDATE as DATE1,  cast(0 as datetime) as RELEASEDATE_I,  'IV_Quantities' as LNITMSEQ,   0 AS CMPNTSEQ,  MRPSITES.BUYERID,  MRPSITES.PLANNERID,  0 as MOVEIN  FROM MRP4040 PEGGING INNER JOIN MRP0101 MRPSITES ON  PEGGING.ITEMNMBR = MRPSITES.ITEMNMBR   AND PEGGING.LOCNCODE = FROM MRP4040 PEGGING INNER JOIN MRP0101 MRPSITES ON  PEGGING.ITEMNMBR = MRPSITES.ITEMNMBR   AND PEGGING.LOCNCODE = MRPSITES.LOCNCODE  AND PEGGING.ORDRPNTQTY <> 0   INNER JOIN MP040000 STATUS ON  1 = STATUS.Status and STATUS.MODULEID = 1  Union all  SELECT   'PEGGING' AS USERID,  PEGGING.ITEMNMBR,  PEGGING.LOCNCODE,  PEGGING.DUEDATE as DATE1,  cast(0 as datetime) as RELEASEDATE_I,  PEGGING.ORDERNUMBER as MANUFACTUREORDER_I,  19 as MRPQTYNUM_I,  -PEGGING.IVREPLENISHMENT as MRP_Number,  STATUS.STSDESCR AS MRPSTATSTR_I,  'LOT' AS MRPTYPESTR_I,   PEGGING.DEX_ROW_ID AS ORD,  0 AS MRPSITES.ITEMNMBR   AND PEGGING.LOCNCODE = MRPSITES.LOCNCODE   AND PEGGING.IVREPLENISHMENT <> 0   INNER JOIN MP040000 STATUS ON  1 = STATUS.Status and STATUS.MODULEID = 1

CREATE VIEW dbo.MOPV0001 AS   select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.PICKLISTSEQ as SEQ_I,a.LOCNCODE,a.ITEMNMBR,  QTY_AVAIL_ALLOCATE_I=  case  when (select count(ITEMNMBR) from IV00101 where ITEMNMBR = a.ITEMNMBR) = 0 THEN   99999999999999  when (select ITEMTYPE from IV00101 where ITEMNMBR = a.ITEMNMBR) > 2 THEN   99999999999999  when (select isnull((select (QTYONHND-ATYALLOC) from IV00102 where ITEMNMBR = a.ITEMNMBR and LOCNCODE=a.LOCNCODE),0)) >= 0 THEN  isnull((select (QTYONHND-ATYALLOC) from IV00102 where ITEMNMBR = a.ITEMNMBR and LOCNCODE=a.LOCNCODE),0)  else   0  end,  QTY_AVAIL_REV_ALLOCATE_I=  isnull((select (ATYALLOC-PENDING_ISSUE_QTY_I) from MOP1400 where MANUFACTUREORDER_I=a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and PICKLISTSEQ=a.PICKLISTSEQ and LOCNCODE=a.LOCNCODE),0),  QTY_AVAIL_ISSUE_I=  case  when (select count(ITEMNMBR) from IV00101 where ITEMNMBR = a.ITEMNMBR) > 0 THEN   (isnull((select (QTYONHND-ATYALLOC) from IV00102 where ITEMNMBR = a.ITEMNMBR and LOCNCODE=a.LOCNCODE),0) +  isnull((select (ATYALLOC-PENDING_ISSUE_QTY_I) from MOP1400 where MANUFACTUREORDER_I=a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I   and PICKLISTSEQ=a.PICKLISTSEQ and LOCNCODE=a.LOCNCODE),0))  else   99999999999999  end,   QTY_AVAIL_REVISSUE_I=  (isnull((select QTY_ISSUED_I from MOP1400 x  where x.MANUFACTUREORDER_I=a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and x.PICKLISTSEQ=a.PICKLISTSEQ and x.LOCNCODE=a.LOCNCODE),0) -  (isnull((select (PENDING_REV_ISS_QTY_I+NUMBERSCRAPPED_I+PENDING_SCRAP_QTY_I) from MOP1400 x  where x.MANUFACTUREORDER_I=a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and x.PICKLISTSEQ=a.PICKLISTSEQ and x.LOCNCODE=a.LOCNCODE),0)+   isnull((select sum(x.QTYSOLD) from MOP1000 x, MOP1400 y where x.MANUFACTUREORDER_I=a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I   and x.MANUFACTUREORDER_I=y.MANUFACTUREORDER_I  and x.PICKLISTSEQ=a.PICKLISTSEQ and x.TO_SITE_I=a.LOCNCODE  and x.FROM_SITE_I=a.LOCNCODE  and x.PICKLISTSEQ=y.PICKLISTSEQ and x.TO_SITE_I=y.LOCNCODE and x.BACKFLUSHITEM_I=0),0))),  DEX_ROW_ID  from MOP1400 a

b.MACHVAROHDCOSTI_1) as MACH_VAR_OHD_DIFF_I,  a.DEX_ROW_ID from IV00101 a,   ICIV0323 b  where a.ITEMNMBR = b.ITEMNMBR and a.VCTNMTHD > 3 and a.ITEMNMBR in (select c.ITEMNMBR from ICIV0323 c where +c.NO_CALC_LAB+c.NO_CALC_LAB_FIX_OHD+c.NO_CALC_LAB_VAR_OHD  +c.NO_CALC_MACH+c.NO_CALC_MACH_FIX_OHD+c.NO_CALC_MACH_VAR_OHD)>0))) or   (c.MATCOSTI_3 <> c.MATCOSTI_1)  and   ((c.MATCOSTI_3 <>0) or (c.MATCOSTI_5=0    and c.NO_CALC_MAT=1)) or  (c.MATFIXOHDCOSTI_3 <> c.MATFIXOHDCOSTI_1) and   ((c.MATFIXOHDCOSTI_3<>0) or (c.MATFIXOHDCOSTI_5=0 and c.NO_CALC_MAT_FIX_OHD=1)) or  (c.MATVAROHDCOSTI_3 <> c.MATVAROHDCOSTI_1) and   ((c.MATVAROHDCOSTI_3<>0) or (c.MATVAROHDCOSTI_5=0 and c.NO_CALC_MAT_VAR_OHD=1)) or   (c.LABCOSTI_1 <> c.LABCOSTI_3) and   ((c.LABCOSTI_3 <> 0) or (c.LABCOSTI_5=0 and c.NO_CALC_LAB=1)) or  (c.LABFIXOHDCOSTI_1 <> c.LABFIXOHDCOSTI_3) and   ((c.LABFIXOHDCOSTI_3 <> 0) or (c.LABFIXOHDCOSTI_5=0 and c.NO_CALC_LAB_FIX_OHD=1)) or  (c.LABVAROHDCOSTI_1 <> c.LABVAROHDCOSTI_3) (c.MACHFIXOHDCOSTI_1 <> c.MACHFIXOHDCOSTI_3) and   ((c.MACHFIXOHDCOSTI_3 <> 0) or (c.MACHFIXOHDCOSTI_5=0 and c.NO_CALC_MACH_FIX_OHD=1)) or  (c.MACHVAROHDCOSTI_1 <> c.MACHVAROHDCOSTI_3) and   ((c.MACHVAROHDCOSTI_3 <> 0) or (c.MACHVAROHDCOSTI_5=0 and c.NO_CALC_MACH_VAR_OHD=1))    or (c.TOTALCOSTI_3=0 and c.TOTALCOSTI_1<>0 and (c.MATCOSTI_1+c.MATFIXOHDCOSTI_1+c.MATVAROHDCOSTI_1)<>0 and create view MOPV1751 as  select distinct a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.LNSEQNBR, a.MO_ACTIVITY_REASON_I, a.IVDOCNBR, b.PICKNUMBER, b.MOPRCTNM,a.DEX_ROW_ID  from MOPV1750 a , IVIC0101 b where a.IVDOCNBR = b.IVDOCNBR and a.MO_ACTIVITY_REASON_I = 56 and b.IVDOCTYP = 1 and a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I not in (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I   from WO010032 where MANUFACTUREORDERST_I = 8) union all  select distinct a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.LNSEQNBR, a.MO_ACTIVITY_REASON_I, a.IVDOCNBR, b.PICKNUMBER, b.MOPRCTNM,a.DEX_ROW_ID  from MOPV1750 a , IVIC0101 b where a.IVDOCNBR = b.IVDOCNBR and a.MO_ACTIVITY_REASON_I = 34 and b.IVDOCTYP = 1 and a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I not in (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I   from WO010032 where MANUFACTUREORDERST_I = 8) and b.PICKNUMBER = case   when b.PICKNUMBER <> '' then isnull((select PICKNUMBER from MOP1200 where TRX_TYPE = 1   and MOP1200.PICKNUMBER = b.PICKNUMBER),'')   else '' end  union all (select * from MOPV1750 where MO_ACTIVITY_REASON_I not in(34,35,56) and MANUFACTUREORDER_I not in (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I   from WO010032 where MANUFACTUREORDERST_I = 8))  union all (select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.LNSEQNBR, a.MO_ACTIVITY_REASON_I, a.IVDOCNBR, b.PICKNUMBER, a.RCPTNMBR , a.DEX_ROW_ID  from MOPV1750 a , MOP10213 b where a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and a.MO_ACTIVITY_REASON_I = 35 and a.LNSEQNBR = b.LNSEQNBR + 1 and a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I not in (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I   from WO010032 where MANUFACTUREORDERST_I = 8))

create view MOPV1752 as select a.DOCTYPE, a.DOCNUMBR, a.DOCDATE, a.ITEMNMBR, a.LNSEQNBR, a.TRXQTY,d.RCPTQTY,a.TRXLOCTN as FromSite, case  when b.LOCNCODE <> ''  then b.LOCNCODE  else a.TRXLOCTN end  as ToSite, b.RTSEQNUM_I, b.PICKLISTSEQ, b.PICKNUMBER, b.PICKDOCLINENUM, b.BACKFLUSHITEM_I, b.MOPRCTNM, b.NUMBERSCRAPPED_I, c.ITMTRKOP, c.VCTNMTHD  from IV30300 a, IVIC0101 b, IV00101 c, MOPV1749 d where a.DOCTYPE = b.IVDOCTYP and a.DOCNUMBR = b.IVDOCNBR  and a.LNSEQNBR = b.LNSEQNBR  and b.PICKLISTSEQ <> 0 and a.ITEMNMBR = c.ITEMNMBR and a.DOCTYPE = d.DOCTYPE and a.DOCNUMBR = d.DOCNUMBR  and a.LNSEQNBR = d.LNSEQNBR  and a.DOCTYPE = 1 and b.IVDOCTYP = 1

CREATE VIEW dbo.ATP_IVXFR_IN AS  SELECT IV00101.ITEMNMBR,   SVC00701.TRNSTLOC AS LOCNCODE,   case   when SVC00700.ETADTE = convert(char(11), '1900/01/01', 100) then SVC00700.ORDRDATE  else SVC00700.ETADTE  end  AS EXPDATE,  9 AS TABLETYPE,  0 AS SOPTYPE,  3 AS DOCTYPE,  SVC00701.ORDDOCID AS DOCNUMBER,  SVC00701.LNITMSEQ,  'Transfer' AS DBCRID,  'Transfer' AS DBCRNAME,  QUANTITY = SVC00701.QTYSHPPD - SVC00701.QTYRECVD,  BACKORDER = 0,  ALLOCATED = 0,  SVC00701.UOFM,  SVC00701.QTYBSUOM,  0 AS BALANCE,  'IVT' AS TYPE  FROM IV00101 LEFT OUTER JOIN SVC00700  INNER JOIN SVC00701 ON SVC00700.ORDDOCID = SVC00701.ORDDOCID   ON IV00101.ITEMNMBR = SVC00701.ITEMNMBR  WHERE SVC00701.QTYSHPPD - SVC00701.QTYRECVD > 0

create view MOPV1754 as select a.DOCNUMBR, a.LNSEQNBR, a.DTLSEQNM,a.RCPTNMBR,a.RCPTQTY,a.RCPTEXCT/a.RCPTQTY as UnitCost, case  when (select count(*) from MOP30301 d where a.DOCTYPE = d.DOCTYPE and a.DOCNUMBR = d.DOCNUMBR  and a.LNSEQNBR = d.LNSEQNBR and a.DTLSEQNM = d.DTLSEQNM) > 0 then  (select DATERECD from MOP30301 d where a.DOCTYPE = d.DOCTYPE and a.DOCNUMBR = d.DOCNUMBR  and a.LNSEQNBR = d.LNSEQNBR and a.DTLSEQNM = d.DTLSEQNM)  else  (select isnull((select top 1 b.DATERECD from IV10200 b where   a.RCPTNMBR = b.RCPTNMBR and a.RCPTEXCT/a.RCPTQTY = b.UNITCOST and b.ITEMNMBR = c.ITEMNMBR and   b.TRXLOCTN = c.FromSite),  (select top 1 b.DATERECD from IV10200 b where   a.RCPTNMBR = b.RCPTNMBR and b.ITEMNMBR = c.ITEMNMBR and   b.TRXLOCTN = c.FromSite)))  end as DATERECD, case  when (select count(*) from MOP30301 d where a.DOCTYPE = d.DOCTYPE and a.DOCNUMBR = d.DOCNUMBR  and a.LNSEQNBR = d.LNSEQNBR and a.DTLSEQNM = d.DTLSEQNM) > 0 then  (select RCTSEQNM from MOP30301 d where a.DOCTYPE = d.DOCTYPE and a.DOCNUMBR = d.DOCNUMBR  and a.LNSEQNBR = d.LNSEQNBR and a.DTLSEQNM = d.DTLSEQNM)  else  (select isnull((select top 1 b.RCTSEQNM from IV10200 b where   a.RCPTNMBR = b.RCPTNMBR and a.RCPTEXCT/a.RCPTQTY = b.UNITCOST and b.ITEMNMBR = c.ITEMNMBR and   b.TRXLOCTN = c.FromSite),  (select top 1 b.RCTSEQNM from IV10200 b where   a.RCPTNMBR = b.RCPTNMBR and b.ITEMNMBR = c.ITEMNMBR and   b.TRXLOCTN = c.FromSite))) end as RCTSEQNM, case  when (select count(*) from IV00101 d where d.ITEMNMBR = c.ITEMNMBR and d.ITMTRKOP > 1) > 0 then  (select count(*) from IV10200 b where   a.RCPTNMBR = b.RCPTNMBR and a.RCPTEXCT/a.RCPTQTY = b.UNITCOST and b.ITEMNMBR = c.ITEMNMBR and   b.TRXLOCTN = c.FromSite)   else 1 end as RecordCount  from IV30301 a, MOPV1752 c where a.DOCTYPE = 1 and a.DOCNUMBR  = c.DOCNUMBR and a.DOCTYPE = c.DOCTYPE and a.LNSEQNBR = c.LNSEQNBR

CREATE VIEW dbo.ATP_IVXFR_VIA AS  SELECT IV00101.ITEMNMBR,   SVC00701.ITLOCN AS LOCNCODE,   case   when SVC00700.ETADTE = convert(char(11), '1900/01/01', 100) then SVC00700.ORDRDATE  else SVC00700.ETADTE  end  AS EXPDATE,  9 AS TABLETYPE,  0 AS SOPTYPE,  3 AS DOCTYPE,  SVC00701.ORDDOCID AS DOCNUMBER,  SVC00701.LNITMSEQ,  'Transfer' AS DBCRID,  'Transfer' AS DBCRNAME,  QUANTITY = case   when SVC00701.QTYFULFI > 0 then abs(SVC00701.QTYFULFI + (SVC00701.QTYSHPPD - SVC00701.QTYRECVD))  when SVC00701.QTYSHPPD > 0 and SVC00701.TRNSFQTY - SVC00701.QTYSHPPD - SVC00701.QTYRECVD > 0 then abs(SVC00701.TRNSFQTY - SVC00701.QTYSHPPD - SVC00701.QTYRECVD)  else 0  end,  BACKORDER = 0,  ALLOCATED = SVC00701.QTYSHPPD,  SVC00701.UOFM,  SVC00701.QTYBSUOM,  0 AS BALANCE,  'IVT' AS TYPE  FROM IV00101 LEFT OUTER JOIN SVC00700  INNER JOIN SVC00701 ON SVC00700.ORDDOCID = SVC00701.ORDDOCID   ON IV00101.ITEMNMBR = SVC00701.ITEMNMBR  WHERE (SVC00701.QTYFULFI > 0) or (SVC00701.QTYSHPPD > 0 and SVC00701.TRNSFQTY - SVC00701.QTYSHPPD - SVC00701.QTYRECVD > 0)

create view MOPV1758 as  select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.PICKNUMBER, a.PICKDOCLINENUM, c.ORIGPICKNUMBER,  c.ORIG_PICK_DOC_LINE_NUM, c.ITEMNMBR, c.PICKLISTSEQ, a.TRXQTY,c.ITMTRKOP, c.VCTNMTHD from MOP1210 a, MOP1200 b, MOPV1757 c where  a.ORIGPICKNUMBER = c.PICKNUMBER and a.ORIG_PICK_DOC_LINE_NUM = c.PICKDOCLINENUM and a.PICKNUMBER = b.PICKNUMBER and b.TRX_TYPE = 6 and b.POSTED = 1

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[IV00702V] AS SELECT     ORDDOCID AS ORDDOCID, TRANSLINESEQ AS LNITMSEQ, QTYTYPE,   SERLTNUM, SERLTQTY, SLTSQNUM, ITEMNMBR,   DATERECD, POSTED, FROMBIN, TOBIN, STATUS AS Status, OVRSERLT,MFGDATE,EXPNDATE,UNITCOST,DTSEQNUM,DEX_ROW_ID FROM         dbo.SVC00702

create view MOPV1759 as select a.MOPRCTNM, a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ, a.QTYTOCONSUME,  a.QTYTOBACKFLUSH, a.BACKFLUSHSITEID, a.NUMBERSCRAPPED_I, a.NONINVENTORY, a.ITEMTYPE, d.CURRCOST, b.WCID_I,  a.ITMTRKOP,d.VCTNMTHD, c.POSTDATE, b.RTSEQNUM_I from MOP1110 a, PK010033 b, MOP1100 c, IV00101 d where a.MOPRCTNM = c.MOPRCTNM  and c.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and a.PICKLISTSEQ = b.SEQ_I and a.ITEMNMBR = d.ITEMNMBR and a.FLOORSTOCK_I = 0 and ((c.REVERSED_RECEIPT_I=0 and (a.QTYTOCONSUME > 0 and a.ITEMTYPE not in (4,5,6)))  or (c.REVERSED_RECEIPT_I=1 and (a.QTYTOCONSUME = 0 and a.ITEMTYPE not in (4,5,6))) or (a.QTYTOBACKFLUSH > 0 and a.ITEMTYPE in (4,5,6) and a.NONINVENTORY = 0))  union all (select a.MOPRCTNM, a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ, a.QTYTOCONSUME,  a.QTYTOBACKFLUSH, a.BACKFLUSHSITEID, a.NUMBERSCRAPPED_I, a.NONINVENTORY, a.ITEMTYPE, b.UNITCOST,  b.WCID_I, a.ITMTRKOP, 1, c.POSTDATE, b.RTSEQNUM_I from MOP1110 a, PK010033 b, MOP1100 c where a.MOPRCTNM = c.MOPRCTNM  and c.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and a.PICKLISTSEQ = b.SEQ_I and a.FLOORSTOCK_I = 0 and a.NONINVENTORY = 1)

create view SVC_ABCD as SELECT distinct  RTV_Number = SVC_RTV_MSTR.RTV_Number,  VendorRMA = SVC_RTV_MSTR.VRMA_Document_ID,   ItemDesc = SVC_RTV_MSTR.ITEMDESC,   VendorItem = SVC_RTV_MSTR.VNDITNUM,   VendorName = SVC_RTV_MSTR.Ship_Address_Name,   PO_Number = SVC_RTV_MSTR.PONMBRSTR,  Name = SVC_Service_MSTR.CUSTNAME,  Address = SVC_Service_MSTR.ADDRESS1,   City = SVC_Service_MSTR.CITY,   State = SVC_Service_MSTR.STATE,   Zip = SVC_Service_MSTR.ZIP,   Contact = SVC_Service_MSTR.CNTCPRSN,   Phone = SVC_Service_MSTR.PHONE1,   DateFailed = SVC_Service_MSTR.ENTDTE,   DateRequested = SVC_Service_MSTR.ETADTE,   DateServiced = SVC_Service_MSTR.COMPDTE,  RepairTime = SVC_Service_MSTR_Line.TRANSTME,  TechName = SVC_Tech_MSTR.NAME,  Failure = SVC_Codes_Problem.DSCRIPTN,  CorrectiveAction = SVC_Codes_Repair.DSCRIPTN,  ItemNumber = SVC_RTV_MSTR.ITEMNMBR FROM  dbo.SVC05601 SVC_RTV_MSTR,  dbo.SVC00200 SVC_Service_MSTR,  dbo.SVC00201 SVC_Service_MSTR_Codes,  dbo.SVC00202 SVC_Service_MSTR_Equipment,  dbo.SVC00203 SVC_Service_MSTR_Line,  dbo.SVC00100 SVC_Tech_MSTR,  dbo.SVC00907 SVC_Codes_Problem,  dbo.SVC00908 SVC_Codes_Repair WHERE  SVC_RTV_MSTR.CALLNBR = SVC_Service_MSTR.CALLNBR AND  SVC_Service_MSTR.SRVRECTYPE = SVC_Service_MSTR_Codes.SRVRECTYPE AND  SVC_Service_MSTR.CALLNBR = SVC_Service_MSTR_Codes.CALLNBR AND  SVC_Service_MSTR.SRVRECTYPE = SVC_Service_MSTR_Equipment.SRVRECTYPE AND  SVC_Service_MSTR.CALLNBR = SVC_Service_MSTR_Equipment.CALLNBR AND  SVC_Service_MSTR.SRVRECTYPE = SVC_Service_MSTR_Line.SRVRECTYPE AND  SVC_Service_MSTR.CALLNBR = SVC_Service_MSTR_Line.CALLNBR AND  SVC_Service_MSTR_Line.TECHID = SVC_Tech_MSTR.TECHID AND  SVC_Service_MSTR_Codes.PROBCDE = SVC_Codes_Problem.PROBCDE AND  SVC_Service_MSTR_Codes.RPRCODE = SVC_Codes_Repair.RPRCODE AND  SVC_Service_MSTR_Line.ITEMUSETYPE = 'R'

create view MOPV1760 as select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,'' as IVDOCNBR, 0 as LNSEQNBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ, a.PICKNUMBER, a.PICKDOCLINENUM, b.TRX_TYPE, ''  as MOPRCTNM,a.TRXQTY as OLDQTY, 0 as NEWQTY   from MOP1210 a, MOP1200 b where  a.PICKNUMBER = b.PICKNUMBER and b.POSTED = 1 and b.TRX_TYPE in (1,2) and a.TRXQTY <> 0  and not exists (select b.PICKNUMBER from MOPV1752 b where a.PICKNUMBER = b.PICKNUMBER and a.PICKDOCLINENUM = b.PICKDOCLINENUM)  union all (select b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, '', 0, a.PICKLISTSEQ, '', 0,1,a.MOPRCTNM, QTYTOBACKFLUSH, 0 from MOP1110 a, MOP1100 b where QTYTOBACKFLUSH <> 0 and a.MOPRCTNM = b.MOPRCTNM and b.REVERSED_RECEIPT_I=0  and NONINVENTORY = 0 and ITEMTYPE in (1,2) and not exists (select b.MOPRCTNM from MOPV1752 b where a.MOPRCTNM = b.MOPRCTNM and a.PICKLISTSEQ = b.PICKLISTSEQ))

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC_BTSV AS SELECT STRTDATE, CONTNBR, LNSEQNBR, CALLNBR = '',   DSCRIPTN AS SVCDESCR, BLKTIM, DEX_ROW_ID + 1000000000 AS DEX_ROW_ID FROM SVC00601 WHERE BILCYC > 1 AND SVC_Liability_Type = 2 UNION SELECT STRTDATE = MAX(H.ENTDTE), H.CONTNBR,   H.SVC_Contract_Line_SEQ, H.CALLNBR, MAX(H.SVCDESCR),   BLKTIM = SUM(QTYSOLD), DEX_ROW_ID = MAX(H.DEX_ROW_ID) FROM SVC00200 H, SVC00203 L WHERE H.CALLNBR = L.CALLNBR and H.SRVRECTYPE = L.SRVRECTYPE AND L.LINITMTYP = 'L' AND H.CONTNBR > '' and (H.SRVRECTYPE = 2 or H.SRVRECTYPE = 3) GROUP BY H.CONTNBR, H.SVC_Contract_Line_SEQ, H.CALLNBR UNION SELECT STRTDATE = MAX(H.ENTDTE), H.CONTNBR,   H.SVC_Contract_Line_SEQ, H.CALLNBR, MAX(H.SVCDESCR),   BLKTIM = SUM(QTYSOLD), DEX_ROW_ID = MAX(H.DEX_ROW_ID) FROM SVC30200 H, SVC30203 L WHERE H.CALLNBR = L.CALLNBR and H.SRVRECTYPE = L.SRVRECTYPE AND L.LINITMTYP = 'L' AND H.CONTNBR > '' and (H.SRVRECTYPE = 2 or H.SRVRECTYPE = 3) GROUP BY H.CONTNBR, H.SVC_Contract_Line_SEQ, H.CALLNBR

create view MOPV1770 as  select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ, sum(a.TRXQTY) as QtyIssued,  0 as QtyReverseIssued, 0 as QtyScrapped, 0 QtyReversedScrapped  from MOP1210 a, MOP1200 b where   a.PICKNUMBER = b.PICKNUMBER  and b.TRX_TYPE = 1  and b.POSTED = 1 and a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I not in   (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I from WO010032 where MANUFACTUREORDERST_I = 8)  group by a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ  union all  (select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ, 0, sum(a.TRXQTY) as QtyReverseIssued, 0, 0  from MOP1210 a, MOP1200 b where   a.PICKNUMBER = b.PICKNUMBER  and b.TRX_TYPE = 2  and b.POSTED = 1 and MANUFACTUREORDER_I not in   (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I from WO010032 where MANUFACTUREORDERST_I = 8)  group by a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ)  union all  (select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ, 0,0,sum(a.TRXQTY) as QtyScrapped, 0  from MOP1210 a, MOP1200 b where   a.PICKNUMBER = b.PICKNUMBER  and b.TRX_TYPE = 5  and b.POSTED = 1 and MANUFACTUREORDER_I not in   (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I from WO010032 where MANUFACTUREORDERST_I = 8)  group by a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ)  union all  select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ, 0,0,0,sum(a.TRXQTY) as QtyReversedScrapped  from MOP1210 a, MOP1200 b where   a.PICKNUMBER = b.PICKNUMBER  and b.TRX_TYPE = 6  and b.POSTED = 1 and MANUFACTUREORDER_I not in   (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I from WO010032 where MANUFACTUREORDERST_I = 8)  group by a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ

create view SVC_Cont_Line_Last_Time as select H.CONTNBR,   H.SVC_Contract_Line_SEQ,   COMPDTE=max(H.COMPDTE),   QTYSOLD=sum(L.QTYSOLD)  from SVC00200 H,   SVC00203 L where H.CALLNBR=L.CALLNBR   and L.LINITMTYP = 'L'   and dateadd(Minute,datepart(Minute,H.COMPTME),dateadd(Hour,datepart(Hour,H.COMPTME),H.COMPDTE)) in   (select max(dateadd(Minute,datepart(Minute,A.COMPTME),dateadd(Hour,datepart(Hour,A.COMPTME),A.COMPDTE)))   from SVC00200 A where A.CONTNBR = H.CONTNBR) group by H.CONTNBR, H.SVC_Contract_Line_SEQ

create view MOPV1774 as  select b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ, sum(abs(QTYTOBACKFLUSH)) as QtyBackflushed,  sum(QTYTOCONSUME) as QtyConsumed, sum(NUMBERSCRAPPED_I) as QtyScrapped  from MOP1110 a, MOP1100 b where   a.MOPRCTNM = b.MOPRCTNM and FLOORSTOCK_I = 0 and REVERSED_RECEIPT_I=0   and b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I not in   (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I from WO010032 where MANUFACTUREORDERST_I = 8)  group by b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.PICKLISTSEQ

CREATE VIEW SVC_Inv_Pivot AS select T.TECHID,  I.ITEMNMBR,  ITEMTYPE = min(IV.ITEMTYPE),  ITEMDESC = min(IV.ITEMDESC),  ITMSHNAM = min(IV.ITMSHNAM),  LISTPRCE = min(IP.LISTPRCE),  ITMTRKOP = min(IV.ITMTRKOP),  RTRNABLE = min(H.RTRNABLE),  METERED = min(H.METERED),  RCRDTYPE=min(I.RCRDTYPE),   GOODQTY=sum(I.QTYONHND*charindex(ltrim(rtrim(I.LOCNCODE)),T.LOCNCODE)),  BADQTY=sum(I.QTYONHND*charindex(ltrim(rtrim(I.LOCNCODE)),T.LOCCODEB)),   GOODATYALLOC=sum(I.ATYALLOC*charindex(ltrim(rtrim(I.LOCNCODE)),T.LOCNCODE)),  BADATYALLOC=sum(I.ATYALLOC*charindex(ltrim(rtrim(I.LOCNCODE)),T.LOCCODEB))   from IV00102 I, IV00101 IV, SVC00951 H , SVC00100 T, IV00105 IP, MC40000 MC  where (I.LOCNCODE = T.LOCNCODE or I.LOCNCODE = T.LOCCODEB) and H.ITEMNMBR = IV.ITEMNMBR  and IV.ITEMNMBR = I.ITEMNMBR and IP.ITEMNMBR = I.ITEMNMBR  and (MC.FUNLCURR = IP.CURNCYID or IP.CURRNIDX = 0)  group by T.TECHID,I.ITEMNMBR

create view MOPV1775 as  select MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR, PICKLISTSEQ, 0 as QtyIssued, 0 as QtyReverseIssued, 0 as QtyScrappedPD, 0 as QtyReverseScrapped, QtyBackflushed, QtyConsumed, QtyScrapped as QtyScrappedR from MOPV1774   union all (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR, PICKLISTSEQ, QtyIssued,   QtyReverseIssued, QtyScrapped, QtyReversedScrapped, 0,0,0 from MOPV1770 )  union all (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR, SEQ_I, CURRENT_CONSUMED_I, 0, 0, 0, 0, CURRENT_CONSUMED_I, 0 from PK010033 where  MANUFACTUREORDER_I not in   (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I from WO010032 where MANUFACTUREORDERST_I = 8 ))

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC0060V AS SELECT SVC00600.CONSTS, SVC00600.CONTNBR, SVC00600.CNTTYPE, SVC00600.MSTCNTRCT,SVC00600.CUSTNMBR,   RM00101.CUSTNAME, SVC00600.ADRSCODE, SVC00600.Bill_To_Customer, SVC00600.SVC_Bill_To_Address_Code,   SVC00600.PORDNMBR, SVC00600.STRTDATE, SVC00600.ENDDATE, SVC00600.DSCRIPTN,  SVC00600.DEX_ROW_ID FROM SVC00600 LEFT OUTER JOIN  RM00101 ON   SVC00600.CUSTNMBR = RM00101.CUSTNMBR

create view MOPV1776 as select MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR, PICKLISTSEQ, sum(QtyIssued) as QtyIssued,  sum(QtyReverseIssued) as QtyReverseIssued, sum(QtyScrappedPD) as QtyScrappedPD,  sum(QtyReverseScrapped) as QtyReverseScrapped, sum(QtyBackflushed) as QtyBackflushed,  sum(QtyConsumed) as QtyConsumed, sum(QtyScrappedR) as QtyScrappedR from MOPV1775 group by MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR, PICKLISTSEQ

CREATE VIEW SVC0200V AS select a.SRVRECTYPE, a.CALLNBR, a.ENTDTE, a.SRVSTAT, b.STSDESCR, a.SRVTYPE, a.PORDNMBR, a.TECHID,  a.CUSTNMBR, a.ADRSCODE, a.CUSTNAME, a.Customer_Reference, a.CONTNBR, a.OFFID, a.ETADTE, a.ETATME,a.COMPDTE, a.COMPTME, 0 as 'HISTORY',a.DEX_ROW_ID  from dbo.SVC00200 a left outer join dbo.SVC00913 b on ( a.SRVSTAT = b.SRVSTAT) union select c.SRVRECTYPE, c.CALLNBR, c.ENTDTE, c.SRVSTAT, b.STSDESCR, c.SRVTYPE, c.PORDNMBR, c.TECHID,  c.CUSTNMBR, c.ADRSCODE, c.CUSTNAME, c.Customer_Reference, c.CONTNBR, c.OFFID, c.ETADTE, c.ETATME,c.COMPDTE, c.COMPTME, 1 as 'HISTORY',c.DEX_ROW_ID + 1000000000  from dbo.SVC30200 c left outer join dbo.SVC00913 b on ( c.SRVSTAT = b.SRVSTAT)

create view MOPV1777 as  select MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR, PICKLISTSEQ,  QtyIssued + QtyBackflushed - QtyReverseIssued as QTYRECVD,  QtyConsumed + QtyBackflushed as QTYSOLD,  QtyScrappedPD + QtyScrappedR - QtyReverseScrapped as NUMBERSCRAPPED_I from MOPV1776

CREATE VIEW AttendanceDetail AS select rtrim(['HR_Division2'].[COMPANYCODE_I]) as 'Company Code', rtrim(ISNULL(['HR_Division2'].[DIVISION_I],'')) as 'Division', rtrim(['TA_SETP_Types'].[PAYRCORD]) as 'Pay Record', 'Time Type' = dbo.DYN_FUNC_Time_Type(['TA_SETP_Types'].[TIMETYPE_I]),  rtrim(['TA_SETP_Types'].[DSCRIPTN]) as 'Time Code Description', ['TA_TRX_Detail'].[HOURS_I] as 'Hours', rtrim(['TA_TRX_Detail'].[DIVISIONCODE_I]) as 'Division Code', rtrim(['TA_TRX_Detail'].[EMPID_I]) as 'Employee ID', ['TA_TRX_Detail'].[TRXDATE] as 'TRX Date', rtrim(['TA_TRX_Detail'].[BACHNUMB]) as 'Batch Number', rtrim(['TA_TRX_Detail'].[DEPRTMNT]) as 'Department', rtrim(['TA_TRX_Detail'].[ATTRSN]) as 'Attendance Reason', 'Attendance TRX Status' = dbo.DYN_FUNC_Attendance_TRX_Status(['TA_TRX_Detail'].[ATTTRXSTATUS]),  ['TA_TRX_Detail'].[TRXENDDT] as 'TRX Ending Date', ['TA_TRX_Detail'].[CMRECNUM] as 'Record Number', rtrim(['Payroll Master'].[SOCSCNUM]) as 'Social Security Number', rtrim(['Payroll Master'].[EMPLCLAS]) as 'Employee Class', rtrim(['Payroll Master'].[JOBTITLE]) as 'Job Title', 'Inactive' = dbo.DYN_FUNC_Boolean_All(['Payroll Master'].[INACTIVE]), rtrim(['Payroll Master'].[LOCATNID]) as 'Location ID', rtrim(['Payroll Master'].[SUPERVISORCODE_I]) as 'Supervisor Code', rtrim(['Payroll Master'].[FRSTNAME]) as 'First Name', rtrim(['Payroll Master'].[LASTNAME]) as 'Last Name', rtrim(['Payroll Master'].[MIDLNAME]) as 'Middle Name', rtrim(['Payroll Master'].[WRKRCOMP]) as 'Workers Master'].[DIVISIONCODE_I] left outer join [UPR40300] as ['Payroll Department Setup'] with (NOLOCK) on ['Payroll Department Setup'].[DEPRTMNT] = ['Payroll Master'].[DEPRTMNT]

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC0201V (SRVRECTYPE, CALLNBR, LNITMSEQ, EQUIPID, ITEMNMBR, PROBCDE, RPRCODE, CAUSECDE, SRVTYPE,  ENTDTE, CUSTNAME, PRDLINE, DEX_ROW_ID) AS   SELECT SVC00201.SRVRECTYPE, SVC00201.CALLNBR, SVC00201.LNITMSEQ, SVC00201.EQUIPID, SVC00201.ITEMNMBR,  SVC00201.PROBCDE, SVC00201.RPRCODE, SVC00201.CAUSECDE, SVC00200.SRVTYPE, SVC00200.ENTDTE, SVC00200.CUSTNAME,  SVC00201.PRDLINE, SVC00201.DEX_ROW_ID  FROM SVC00201 JOIN SVC00200 ON ( SVC00201.SRVRECTYPE = SVC00200.SRVRECTYPE AND SVC00201.CALLNBR = SVC00200.CALLNBR )  union SELECT SVC30201.SRVRECTYPE, SVC30201.CALLNBR, SVC30201.LNITMSEQ, SVC30201.EQUIPID, SVC30201.ITEMNMBR,  SVC30201.PROBCDE, SVC30201.RPRCODE, SVC30201.CAUSECDE, SVC30200.SRVTYPE, SVC30200.ENTDTE, SVC30200.CUSTNAME,  SVC30201.PRDLINE, SVC30201.DEX_ROW_ID + 1000000000  FROM SVC30201 JOIN SVC30200 ON ( SVC30201.SRVRECTYPE = SVC30200.SRVRECTYPE AND SVC30201.CALLNBR = SVC30200.CALLNBR )

create view MOPV1778 as  select MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR, PICKLISTSEQ,  sum(QTYRECVD) as QTYRECVD, sum(QTYSOLD) as QTYSOLD,  sum(NUMBERSCRAPPED_I) as NUMBERSCRAPPED_I from MOP1000 group by MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR, PICKLISTSEQ

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC0202V (EQUIPID, EQPLINE, ITEMNMBR, CALLNBR, SRVRECTYPE, TECHID,  SRVTYPE, ENTDTE, COMPDTE, COMPTME, PROBCDE, OFFID, SRVSTAT, CONTNBR, CUSTNMBR, CUSTNAME, DEX_ROW_ID)  AS   SELECT SVC00202.EQUIPID, SVC00202.EQPLINE, SVC00202.ITEMNMBR, SVC00202.CALLNBR, SVC00202.SRVRECTYPE, SVC00200.TECHID,  SVC00200.SRVTYPE, SVC00200.ENTDTE, SVC00200.COMPDTE, SVC00200.COMPTME, SVC00201.PROBCDE, SVC00200.OFFID,  SVC00200.SRVSTAT, SVC00200.CONTNBR, SVC00200.CUSTNMBR, SVC00200.CUSTNAME, SVC00202.DEX_ROW_ID  FROM SVC00202 JOIN SVC00200 ON ( SVC00202.SRVRECTYPE = SVC00200.SRVRECTYPE AND SVC00202.CALLNBR = SVC00200.CALLNBR )  JOIN SVC00201 ON ( SVC00202.SRVRECTYPE = SVC00201.SRVRECTYPE AND SVC00202.CALLNBR = SVC00201.CALLNBR AND SVC00202.EQPLINE = SVC00201.LNITMSEQ )  union SELECT SVC30202.EQUIPID, SVC30202.EQPLINE, SVC30202.ITEMNMBR, SVC30202.CALLNBR, SVC30202.SRVRECTYPE, SVC30200.TECHID, SVC30200.SRVTYPE, SVC30200.ENTDTE, SVC30200.COMPDTE, SVC30200.COMPTME, SVC30201.PROBCDE, SVC30200.OFFID, SVC30200.SRVSTAT, SVC30200.CONTNBR, SVC30200.CUSTNMBR,SVC30200.CUSTNAME,SVC30202.DEX_ROW_ID+1000000000 FROM SVC30202 JOIN SVC30200 ON ( SVC30202.SRVRECTYPE = SVC30200.SRVRECTYPE AND SVC30202.CALLNBR = SVC30200.CALLNBR )  JOIN SVC30201 ON ( SVC30202.SRVRECTYPE = SVC30201.SRVRECTYPE AND SVC30202.CALLNBR = SVC30201.CALLNBR AND SVC30202.EQPLINE = SVC30201.LNITMSEQ )

create view MOPV1790 as  select QTYS.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, QTYS.FGITEMNMBR, QTYS.ITEMNMBR,  QTYS.DECPLQTY, isnull(sum(OLDRECVD), 0) as OLDRECVD, isnull(sum(OLDSOLD), 0) as OLDSOLD,  isnull(sum(NEWRECVD), 0) as NEWRECVD, isnull(sum(NEWSOLD), 0) as NEWSOLD from   (  select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.ITEMNMBR as FGITEMNMBR,  b.ITEMNMBR,  d.DECPLQTY, OLDRECVD,  OLDSOLD,  cast(0 as numeric(19,5)) as NEWRECVD,  cast(0 as numeric(19,5)) as NEWSOLD   from WO010032 a left outer join    (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR, sum(QTYRECVD) as OLDRECVD, sum(QTYSOLD) as OLDSOLD  from MOP1000Rebuild group by MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR) b   on a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I  inner join  IV00101 d on d.ITEMNMBR = b.ITEMNMBR  union all   (select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.ITEMNMBR as FGITEMNMBR,  c.ITEMNMBR,  d.DECPLQTY,   cast(0 as numeric(19,5)) as OLDRECVD,  cast(0 as numeric(19,5)) as OLDSOLD,  NEWRECVD,  NEWSOLD   from WO010032 a left outer join   (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR, sum(QTYRECVD) as NEWRECVD, sum(QTYSOLD) as NEWSOLD  from MOP1000 group by MANUFACTUREORDER_I, ITEMNMBR) c   on a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = c.MANUFACTUREORDER_I  inner join  IV00101 d on d.ITEMNMBR = c.ITEMNMBR)) QTYS  group by QTYS.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, QTYS.FGITEMNMBR, QTYS.ITEMNMBR,  QTYS.DECPLQTY

create view MOPV1810 as   select   MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, LOCNCODE,   count(SERLTQTY) - sum(QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I) as QTYIssued,  sum(NUMBERSCRAPPED_I) as NUMBERSCRAPPED_I,  sum(QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I) as QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I,  sum(QTYCONSUMED) as QTYCONSUMED  from WO010515   group by MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, LOCNCODE   union all   (select MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, LOCNCODE,   sum(SERLTQTY) - sum(QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I) as QTYIssued,  sum(NUMBERSCRAPPED_I) as NUMBERSCRAPPED_I,  sum(QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I) as QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I,  sum(QTYCONSUMED) as QTYCONSUMED  from WO010302   group by MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, LOCNCODE)    union all  (select  MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, FROM_SITE_I,  sum(QUANTITY) - sum(QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I) as QTYIssued,  sum(NUMBERSCRAPPED_I) as NUMBERSCRAPPED_I,  sum(QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I) as QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I,  sum(QTYCONSUMED) as QTYCONSUMED  from MOP1027   group by MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, FROM_SITE_I)   union all  (select  b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.PICKLISTSEQ, a.BACKFLUSHSITEID,  0 as QTYIssued,  sum(a.NUMBERSCRAPPED_I) as NUMBERSCRAPPED_I,  sum(a.QTYTOBACKFLUSH) as QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I,  0 as QTYCONSUMED  from MOP1110 a, MOP1100 b where  a.FLOORSTOCK_I = 1  and a.MOPRCTNM = b.MOPRCTNM and b.REVERSED_RECEIPT_I=0   group by b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.PICKLISTSEQ, a.BACKFLUSHSITEID)

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC0615V AS SELECT CONSTS, CONTNBR, Bill_To_Customer,SVC_Bill_To_Address_Code  from SVC00601 where CONSTS = 2   group by CONSTS, CONTNBR, Bill_To_Customer, SVC_Bill_To_Address_Code

create view MOPV1820   as  select b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,b.PICKLISTSEQ,b.FROM_SITE_I, sum(b.TRXQTY) TRXQTY  from MOP1200 a, MOP1210 b  where b.PICKNUMBER = a.PICKNUMBER  and a.TRX_TYPE = 1  and a.POSTED = 0  group by b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,b.PICKLISTSEQ,b.FROM_SITE_I

CREATE VIEW EmplAttendDetail AS select ['T1'].[TRX_I] as 'TRX', ['T1'].[EMPID_I] as 'Employee ID', rtrim(['T2'].[LASTNAME]) + ', ' + rtrim(['T2'].[FRSTNAME]) as 'Employee Name', ['T2'].[STRTDATE] as 'Start Date', ['T1'].[JOBTITLE] as 'Job Title', ['T1'].[DEPRTMNT] as 'Department', ['T1'].[TIMECODE_I] as 'Time Code', ['T1'].[TRXDATE] as 'TRX Date', ['T1'].[TRXENDDT] as 'TRX Ending Date', convert(decimal(9,2), (['T1'].[HOURS_I]/100.00)) as 'Hours', 'Accrual Flag' = dbo.DYN_FUNC_Boolean_All(['T1'].[ACCFLG]), 'Accrue Time Benefits' = dbo.DYN_FUNC_Boolean_All(['T1'].[ACCRUETIMEBENEFITS_I]), 'Posted' = dbo.DYN_FUNC_Boolean_All(['T1'].[POSTED]), ['T1'].[ATTTYP] as 'Attendance Type', ['T1'].[ATTRSN] as 'Attendance Reason'           from [TATX1030] as ['T1'] WITH (NOLOCK)  INNER JOIN [UPR00100] as ['T2']  WITH (NOLOCK) on ['T2'].[EMPLOYID] =  ['T1'].[EMPID_I]

create view ASIV0001 as select   POPRCTNM,   RCPTLNNM,   sum(QTYSHPPD) as QTYSHPPD,   sum(QTYINVCD) as QTYINVCD,   sum(QTYREJ) as QTYREJ,   max(Total_Landed_Cost_Amount) as Total_Landed_Cost_Amount,  sum(QTYRESERVED) as QTYRESERVED,  sum(QTYINVRESERVE) as QTYINVRESERVE,  sum(QTYMATCH) as QTYMATCH,  max(DEX_ROW_ID) as DEX_ROW_ID  from POP10500 where Status <> 2 group by POPRCTNM, RCPTLNNM
CREATE VIEW SVC3020V AS SELECT SOPTYPE, SOPNUMBE, DOCID, DOCDATE, LOCNCODE, CUSTNMBR, CUSTNAME, CSTPONBR,DEX_ROW_ID FROM SOP30200 where SOPTYPE = 3 and VOIDSTTS = 0

create view MOPV1830   as   select b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,b.PICKLISTSEQ,b.TO_SITE_I, sum(b.TRXQTY) TRXQTY  from MOP1200 a, MOP1210 b  where b.PICKNUMBER = a.PICKNUMBER  and a.TRX_TYPE = 2  and a.POSTED = 0  group by b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,b.PICKLISTSEQ,b.TO_SITE_I

CREATE VIEW Hours AS select ['T2'].[EMPLOYID] as 'Employee ID', rtrim(['T2'].[LASTNAME]) + ', ' + rtrim(['T2'].[FRSTNAME]) as 'Employee Name', ['T1'].[TIMECODE_I] as 'Time Code', convert(decimal(9,2),(convert(decimal(9,2), ['T1'].[HOURSAVAILABLE_I]) / 100)) as 'Hours Available'           from [TATM1030] as ['T1'] WITH (NOLOCK)  INNER JOIN [UPR00100] as ['T2'] WITH (NOLOCK) on ['T2'].[EMPLOYID] =  ['T1'].[EMPID_I]

create view ASIV0002 as  select   PONUMBER,  POLNENUM as ORD,  sum(QTYSHPPD) as QTYSHPPD,  sum(QTYINVCD) as QTYINVCD,  sum(QTYREJ) as QTYREJ,  max(Total_Landed_Cost_Amount) as Total_Landed_Cost_Amount,  sum(QTYRESERVED) as QTYRESERVED,  sum(QTYINVRESERVE) as QTYINVRESERVE,   sum(QTYMATCH) as QTYMATCH,   max(DEX_ROW_ID) as DEX_ROW_ID  from POP10500  where Status <> 2 group by PONUMBER,POLNENUM

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC3060V AS SELECT SVC30600.CONSTS, SVC30600.CONTNBR, SVC30600.SVC_Contract_Version, SVC30600.CNTTYPE, SVC30600.MSTCNTRCT,SVC30600.CUSTNMBR,   RM00101.CUSTNAME, SVC30600.ADRSCODE, SVC30600.Bill_To_Customer, SVC30600.SVC_Bill_To_Address_Code,   SVC30600.PORDNMBR, SVC30600.STRTDATE, SVC30600.ENDDATE, SVC30600.DSCRIPTN,  SVC30600.DEX_ROW_ID FROM SVC30600 LEFT OUTER JOIN  RM00101 ON   SVC30600.CUSTNMBR = RM00101.CUSTNMBR

create view MOPV1840   as   select b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,b.PICKLISTSEQ,c.FROM_SITE_I, sum(b.TRXQTY) TRXQTY  from MOP1200 a, MOP1210 b,MOP1210 c   where b.PICKNUMBER = a.PICKNUMBER  and a.TRX_TYPE = 5  and a.POSTED = 0  and c.PICKNUMBER = b.ORIGPICKNUMBER and  c.PICKDOCLINENUM = b.ORIG_PICK_DOC_LINE_NUM  group by b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,b.PICKLISTSEQ,c.FROM_SITE_I

CREATE VIEW HRPCombined AS select ['a'].[EMPLOYID] as 'Employee ID', rtrim(['a'].[LASTNAME]) + ', ' + rtrim(['a'].[FRSTNAME]) as 'Employee Name', ['a'].[Primary_Pay_Record] as 'Primary Pay Code', ['b'].[PAYRCORD] as 'Pay Code', ['b'].[PAYRTAMT] as 'Pay Rate Amount', ['b'].[PAYUNIT] as 'Pay Unit', ['c'].[PAYRTAMT] as 'Primary Pay Rate', ['e'].[TIMECODE_I] as 'Time Code', convert(decimal(9,2),['e'].[HOURSAVAILABLE_I]/100) as 'Time Available', case ['b'].[PAYUNIT] when 'Hourly'   then convert(decimal(9,2), (['b'].[PAYRTAMT] * (['e'].[HOURSAVAILABLE_I]/100.00)))    else convert(decimal(9,2), (['b'].[PAYRTAMT] * (['e'].[HOURSAVAILABLE_I]/100.00) / ['a'].[WKHRPRYR]))  end as 'Liability'           from [UPR00100] as ['a'] WITH (NOLOCK)  left outer join [UPR00400] as ['b'] WITH (NOLOCK) on ['a'].[EMPLOYID] = ['b'].[EMPLOYID] left outer join [UPR00400] as ['c'] WITH (NOLOCK) on ['a'].[EMPLOYID] = ['c'].[EMPLOYID] and ['a'].[Primary_Pay_Record] = ['c'].[PAYRCORD] left outer join [TATM0130] as ['d'] WITH (NOLOCK) on ['b'].[PAYRCORD] = ['d'].[PAYRCORD] left outer join [TATM1030] as ['e'] WITH (NOLOCK) on ['e'].[TIMECODE_I] = ['d'].[TIMECODE_I]  and ['e'].[EMPID_I] = ['b'].[EMPLOYID]

CREATE VIEW dbo.ATP_BOM AS  SELECT IV00101.ITEMNMBR,  BM10300.LOCNCODE,  BM10200.TRXDATE AS EXPDATE,  4 AS TABLETYPE,  0 AS SOPTYPE,  0 AS DOCTYPE,  BM10300.TRX_ID AS DOCNUMBER,  BM10300.Component_ID AS LNITMSEQ,  '' AS DBCRID,  '' AS DBCRNAME,  BM10300.Stock_Quantity AS QUANTITY,  0 AS BACKORDER,  BM10300.ATYALLOC AS ALLOCATED,  BM10300.UOFM,  BM10300.QTYBSUOM,  0 AS BALANCE,  '' AS TYPE FROM BM10200 INNER JOIN  BM10300 ON   BM10200.TRX_ID = BM10300.TRX_ID INNER JOIN  IV00101 ON   BM10300.ITEMNMBR = IV00101.ITEMNMBR WHERE (BM10300.Parent_Component_ID >= 0) AND   (BM10200.BM_Trx_Status = 3)

CREATE VIEW SVC3200V AS select a.SOPTYPE, a.SOPNUMBE, a.CUSTNMBR, a.CUSTNAME, a.CSTPONBR, a.DOCDATE, b.CMPNTSEQ, b.LNITMSEQ, b.ITEMNMBR, b.ITEMDESC, b.LOCNCODE, b.UOFM,  b.PRCLEVEL, b.EXTDCOST, b.XTNDPRCE, b.QTYFULFI, b.DEX_ROW_ID  from SOP30200 a INNER JOIN SOP30300 b ON (a.SOPTYPE = b.SOPTYPE AND a.SOPNUMBE = b.SOPNUMBE)  where a.SOPTYPE = 3

create view MOPV1850   as   select m.FROM_SITE_I, SCRAPTRX.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, SCRAPTRX.REVSCRPPICKNUMBER, SCRAPTRX.REVSCRPPICKDOCLINENUM, SCRAPTRX.REVSCRPPICKLISTSEQ, m.TRXQTY from MOP1210 m,   (select x.TRX_TYPE,x.PICKNUMBER, x.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,x.PICKDOCLINENUM, x.ORIGPICKNUMBER, x.ORIG_PICK_DOC_LINE_NUM, x.PICKLISTSEQ, x.FROM_SITE_I,  y.PICKNUMBER as REVSCRPPICKNUMBER, y.PICKDOCLINENUM as REVSCRPPICKDOCLINENUM, y.PICKLISTSEQ as REVSCRPPICKLISTSEQ  from MOP1210 x, MOP1210 y, MOP1200 z where  x.PICKNUMBER = y.ORIGPICKNUMBER and  x.PICKDOCLINENUM = y.ORIG_PICK_DOC_LINE_NUM and   x.PICKLISTSEQ =  y.PICKLISTSEQ and   x.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = y.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and  z.TRX_TYPE = 6 and z.POSTED = 0 and  y.PICKNUMBER = z.PICKNUMBER) as SCRAPTRX where   m.PICKNUMBER = SCRAPTRX.ORIGPICKNUMBER and  m.PICKDOCLINENUM = SCRAPTRX.ORIG_PICK_DOC_LINE_NUM and   m.PICKLISTSEQ =  SCRAPTRX.PICKLISTSEQ  and  m.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = SCRAPTRX.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and  m.TO_SITE_I = SCRAPTRX.FROM_SITE_I

CREATE VIEW PrimaryPay AS select ['A'].[EMPLOYID] as 'Employee ID', rtrim(['A'].[LASTNAME]) + ', ' + rtrim(['A'].[FRSTNAME]) as 'Employee Name', ['A'].[Primary_Pay_Record] as 'Primary Pay Code', ['B'].[PAYRCORD] as 'Pay Code', ['B'].[PAYRTAMT] as 'Pay Rate Amount'           from [UPR00100] ['A'] WITH (NOLOCK) join [UPR00400] ['B']  WITH (NOLOCK) on ['A'].[EMPLOYID] = ['B'].[EMPLOYID]

CREATE VIEW dbo.ATP_BOMWIP AS  SELECT IV00101.ITEMNMBR,  BM10300.LOCNCODE,   BM10200.TRXDATE AS EXPDATE,  5 AS TABLETYPE,   0 AS SOPTYPE,  0 AS DOCTYPE,   BM10300.TRX_ID AS DOCNUMBER,   BM10300.Component_ID AS LNITMSEQ,  'Assembly' AS DBCRID,   'Assembly' AS DBCRNAME,   BM10300.Assemble_Quantity AS QUANTITY,   0 AS BACKORDER,  0 AS ALLOCATED,  BM10300.UOFM,   BM10300.QTYBSUOM,  0 AS BALANCE,  '' AS TYPE FROM BM10200 INNER JOIN  BM10300 ON   BM10200.TRX_ID = BM10300.TRX_ID INNER JOIN  IV00101 ON   BM10300.ITEMNMBR = IV00101.ITEMNMBR WHERE (BM10300.Parent_Component_ID < 0) AND   (BM10200.BM_Trx_Status = 3)

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC36030V AS  SELECT CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version, SUM(DOCAMNT) AS DOCAMNT,   SUM(PSTDAMNT) AS PSTDAMNT,   SUM(SVC_Invoice_Credit_Amoun)   AS SVC_Invoice_Credit_Amoun, SUM(ORDOCAMT)   AS ORDOCAMT, SUM(ORIGPSTDAMNT) AS ORIGPSTDAMNT,   SUM(OrigInvCreditAmt) AS OrigInvCreditAmt, INVODATE,   POSTED, MAX(DEX_ROW_ID) AS DEX_ROW_ID FROM SVC30603 WHERE (POSTED = 0) GROUP BY CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version, INVODATE, POSTED

create view MOPV1860 as  select MANUFACTUREORDER_I , PICKLISTSEQ , FROM_SITE_I,  sum(QTYRECVD) as QTYIssued,   sum(QTYSOLD) as QTYConsumed  from MOP1000 where BACKFLUSHITEM_I = 0   group by  MANUFACTUREORDER_I , PICKLISTSEQ , FROM_SITE_I

CREATE VIEW PTOLiability AS select ['a'].[EMPID_I] as 'Employee ID', rtrim(['b'].[LASTNAME]) + ', ' + rtrim(['b'].[FRSTNAME]) as 'Employee Name', ['a'].[TIMECODE_I] as 'Time Code', ['c'].[PAYRCORD] as 'Pay Code', ['a'].[HOURSAVAILABLE_I] / 100.0000 as 'Hours Available',  case ['d'].[PAYUNIT] when ' '   then convert(decimal(9,5), ['d'].[PAYRTAMT]/['b'].[WKHRPRYR])   else ['d'].[PAYRTAMT]  end as 'Pay Rate Per Hour',  case ['d'].[PAYUNIT] when ' '   then convert(decimal(9,2), ['d'].[PAYRTAMT]/['b'].[WKHRPRYR] * ['a'].[HOURSAVAILABLE_I] / 100.0000)   else ['d'].[PAYRTAMT] * ['a'].[HOURSAVAILABLE_I] / 100.00000  end as 'Liability'           from [TATM1030] AS ['a']  join [UPR00100] AS ['b'] on ['b'].[EMPLOYID] = ['a'].[EMPID_I]  join [TATM0130] AS ['c'] on ['a'].[TIMECODE_I] = ['c'].[TIMECODE_I]  join [UPR00400] AS ['d'] on ['a'].[EMPID_I] = ['d'].[EMPLOYID] and ['c'].[PAYRCORD] = ['d'].[PAYRCORD]  where ['a'].[TIMETYPE_I] = 4

CREATE VIEW dbo.ATP_POP AS  SELECT IV00101.ITEMNMBR,  POP10110.LOCNCODE,  POP10110.PRMDATE AS EXPDATE,  2 AS TABLETYPE,  0 AS SOPTYPE,  POP10110.POTYPE AS DOCTYPE,  POP10110.PONUMBER AS DOCNUMBER,  POP10110.ORD AS LNITMSEQ,  POP10100.VENDORID AS DBCRID,  POP10100.VENDNAME AS DBCRNAME,  QUANTITY = (QTYCMTBASE + QTYUNCMTBASE) - sum(isnull(POP10500.QTYSHPPD, 0)),  0 AS BACKORDER,  0 AS ALLOCATED,  POP10110.UOFM,  1 AS QTYBSUOM,  0 AS BALANCE,  '' AS TYPE FROM POP10100 INNER JOIN   POP10110 ON   POP10100.PONUMBER = POP10110.PONUMBER  RIGHT OUTER JOIN   IV00101 ON POP10110.ITEMNMBR = IV00101.ITEMNMBR  LEFT OUTER JOIN   POP10500 ON POP10500.PONUMBER = POP10110.PONUMBER  and POP10500.POLNENUM = POP10110.ORD and POP10500.POPTYPE in (1,3)   and POP10500.Status = 0 WHERE ((POP10110.QTYUNCMTBASE >0) OR (POP10110.QTYCMTBASE > 0))  AND  ((POP10110.POLNESTA = 2) OR (POP10110.POLNESTA = 3)) AND   (POP10110.POTYPE <> 2) AND (POP10110.PONUMBER <> '') group by POP10110.PONUMBER, POP10110.POTYPE, IV00101.ITEMNMBR, POP10110.LOCNCODE, POP10110.PRMDATE,  POP10110.ORD, POP10100.VENDORID, POP10100.VENDNAME, POP10110.UOFM,   POP10110.QTYCMTBASE,POP10110.QTYUNCMTBASE

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC36031V AS  SELECT CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version, SUM(DOCAMNT) AS DOCAMNT,   SUM(PSTDAMNT) AS PSTDAMNT,   SUM(SVC_Invoice_Credit_Amoun)   AS SVC_Invoice_Credit_Amoun, SUM(ORDOCAMT)   AS ORDOCAMT, SUM(ORIGPSTDAMNT) AS ORIGPSTDAMNT,   SUM(OrigInvCreditAmt) AS OrigInvCreditAmt, INVODATE,   POSTED, MAX(DEX_ROW_ID) AS DEX_ROW_ID FROM SVC30603 WHERE (POSTED = 1) GROUP BY CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version, INVODATE, POSTED
create view MOPV1870 as   select  MANUFACTUREORDER_I , PICKLISTSEQ , FROM_SITE_I,  sum(NUMBERSCRAPPED_I) as NUMBERSCRAPPED_I  from MOP1000  group by  MANUFACTUREORDER_I , PICKLISTSEQ , FROM_SITE_I

CREATE VIEW PC_Seat_Employer_Exp AS select rtrim(['A'].[PlanCode]) as 'Plan Code', rtrim(['A'].[PlanDesc]) as 'Plan Code Description', rtrim(['A'].[Position]) as 'Position Code', rtrim(['A'].[PosDescription]) as 'Position Code Description', rtrim(['A'].[Department]) as 'Department', rtrim(['A'].[DepDescription]) as 'Department Description', rtrim(cast(datepart(mm,['A'].[StartDate]) as varchar(2))) + '/' +  rtrim(cast(datepart(dd,['A'].[StartDate]) as varchar(2))) + '/' +  rtrim(cast(datepart(yy,['A'].[StartDate]) as varchar(4))) as 'Seats Start Date', rtrim(cast(datepart(mm,['A'].[EndDate]) as varchar(2))) + '/' +   rtrim(cast(datepart(dd,['A'].[EndDate]) as varchar(2))) + '/' +   rtrim(cast(datepart(yy,['A'].[EndDate]) as varchar(4))) as 'Seats End Date', ['A'].[SeatNumber] as 'Seat', rtrim(['A'].[SeatDesc]) as 'Seat Description', ['A'].[TempSeat] as 'Temporary Seat', rtrim(['A'].[EmployeeID]) as 'Employee ID', rtrim(['A'].[EmployeeName]) as 'Employee Name', rtrim(cast(datepart(mm,['A'].[Date]) as varchar(2))) + '/' +  rtrim(cast(datepart(dd,['A'].[Date]) as varchar(2))) + '/' +    rtrim(cast(datepart(yy,['A'].[Date]) as varchar(4))) as 'ER Expense Date', ['A'].[WageAmount] as 'Wage Expense', ['A'].[BenefitsAmount] as 'Benefit Expense', ['A'].[TaxAmount] as 'Tax Expense'  FROM PC_EmployerCostDaily('*CURRENT',0) as ['A']

CREATE VIEW ATP_POP_REC AS  SELECT IV00101.ITEMNMBR,  REC.TRXLOCTN AS LOCNCODE,  POP10300.receiptdate AS EXPDATE,  7 AS TABLETYPE,  0 AS SOPTYPE,  POP10300.POPTYPE AS DOCTYPE,  REC.POPRCTNM AS DOCNUMBER,  REC.RCPTLNNM AS LNITMSEQ,  POP10300.VENDORID AS DBCRID,  POP10300.VENDNAME AS DBCRNAME,  REC.QTYSHPPD as QUANTITY,  0 AS BACKORDER,  0 AS ALLOCATED,  REC.UOFM,  REC.UMQTYINB AS QTYBSUOM,  0 AS BALANCE,  '' AS TYPE  FROM IV00101 LEFT OUTER JOIN  POP10300 INNER JOIN  POP10500 as REC ON  (POP10300.POPRCTNM = REC.POPRCTNM) AND  (POP10300.POPTYPE = REC.POPTYPE) ON   IV00101.ITEMNMBR = REC.ITEMNMBR  WHERE  (REC.QTYSHPPD > 0) AND  (Status = 0)

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC36040V AS SELECT CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version, LNSEQNBR, YEAR1, PERIODID,   SUM(Transaction_Amount - SVC_Invoice_Credit_Amoun)   AS Transaction_Amount,   SUM(OrigTransactionAmount - OrigInvCreditAmt)   AS OrigTransactionAmount, SUM(DSCDLRAM) AS DSCDLRAM,   SUM(ORDDLRAT) AS ORDDLRAT,   SUM(Net_Transaction_Amount) AS Net_Transaction_Amount,   SUM(OrigNetTransactionAmount)   AS OrigNetTransactionAmount, SUM(PSTDAMNT)   AS PSTDAMNT, SUM(Originating_PostedAmount)   AS Originating_PostedAmount, MAX(DEX_ROW_ID)   AS DEX_ROW_ID FROM SVC30604 WHERE (Status = 0) GROUP BY CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version, LNSEQNBR, YEAR1, PERIODID

create view MOPV1880 as   select MANUFACTUREORDER_I , PICKLISTSEQ , FROM_SITE_I, sum(QTYSOLD) as QTYBackflushed   from MOP1000 where BACKFLUSHITEM_I = 1 and ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_10 >= 0  group by  MANUFACTUREORDER_I , PICKLISTSEQ , FROM_SITE_I   union all  (select  b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.PICKLISTSEQ, a.BACKFLUSHSITEID,  sum(a.QTYTOBACKFLUSH) as QTY_BACKFLUSHED_I  from MOP1110 a, MOP1100 b where  a.FLOORSTOCK_I = 1  and a.MOPRCTNM = b.MOPRCTNM and b.REVERSED_RECEIPT_I=0  group by b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.PICKLISTSEQ, a.BACKFLUSHSITEID)

CREATE VIEW ATP_POP_RET AS  SELECT a.ITEMNMBR,  b.TRXLOCTN AS LOCNCODE,  b.DATERECD AS EXPDATE,  8 AS TABLETYPE,  0 AS SOPTYPE,  b.POPTYPE AS DOCTYPE,  b.POPRCTNM AS DOCNUMBER,  b.RCPTLNNM AS LNITMSEQ,  c.VENDORID AS DBCRID,  c.VENDNAME AS DBCRNAME,  b.QTYRESERVED as QUANTITY,  0 AS BACKORDER,  0 AS ALLOCATED,  b.UOFM,  b.UMQTYINB AS QTYBSUOM,  0 AS BALANCE,  '' AS TYPE  from  IV00101 a, POP10500 b, PM00200 c where b.POPTYPE in (4,5,6,7)   and   b.Status = 0     and   b.ITEMNMBR = a.ITEMNMBR  and   b.QTYRESERVED > 0  and   b.VENDORID = c.VENDORID

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC36041V AS SELECT CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version, LNSEQNBR, YEAR1, PERIODID,   SUM(Transaction_Amount - SVC_Invoice_Credit_Amoun)   AS Transaction_Amount,   SUM(OrigTransactionAmount - OrigInvCreditAmt)   AS OrigTransactionAmount, SUM(DSCDLRAM) AS DSCDLRAM,   SUM(ORDDLRAT) AS ORDDLRAT,   SUM(Net_Transaction_Amount) AS Net_Transaction_Amount,   SUM(OrigNetTransactionAmount)   AS OrigNetTransactionAmount, SUM(PSTDAMNT)   AS PSTDAMNT, SUM(Originating_PostedAmount)   AS Originating_PostedAmount, MAX(DEX_ROW_ID)   AS DEX_ROW_ID FROM SVC30604 WHERE (Status =1) GROUP BY CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version, LNSEQNBR, YEAR1, PERIODID
create view MOPV1890 as   select MANUFACTUREORDER_I , PICKLISTSEQ , LOCNCODE, sum(ATYALLOC) as ATYALLOC  from MOP1410  group by  MANUFACTUREORDER_I , PICKLISTSEQ , LOCNCODE

CREATE VIEW dbo.ATP_SOP AS  SELECT IV00101.ITEMNMBR,   SOP10200.LOCNCODE,   SOP10200.ReqShipDate AS EXPDATE,  1 AS TABLETYPE,  SOP10200.SOPTYPE AS SOPTYPE,  0 AS DOCTYPE,  SOP10200.SOPNUMBE AS DOCNUMBER,  SOP10200.LNITMSEQ,  SOP10100.CUSTNMBR AS DBCRID,  SOP10100.CUSTNAME AS DBCRNAME,  QUANTITY =  CASE SOP10200.SOPTYPE  WHEN 4  THEN QTYONHND  ELSE  SOP10200.QTYREMAI   END,   BACKORDER =   CASE SOP10200.SOPTYPE  WHEN 2  THEN QTYTBAOR  WHEN 3  THEN QTYTBAOR  WHEN 4  THEN 0  WHEN 5  THEN QTYTOINV + QTYTORDR  WHEN 6  THEN QTYTBAOR  END,  ALLOCATED =  CASE SOP10200.SOPTYPE  WHEN 4   THEN 0  ELSE  SOP10200.ATYALLOC  END,  SOP10200.UOFM,  SOP10200.QTYBSUOM,  0 AS BALANCE,  '' AS TYPE  FROM IV00101 LEFT OUTER JOIN  SOP10100 INNER JOIN  SOP10200 ON   SOP10100.SOPTYPE = SOP10200.SOPTYPE AND   SOP10100.SOPNUMBE = SOP10200.SOPNUMBE ON   IV00101.ITEMNMBR = SOP10200.ITEMNMBR  WHERE (SOP10200.SOPTYPE = 2 OR  SOP10200.SOPTYPE = 3 OR  (SOP10200.SOPTYPE = 4 AND QTYONHND > 0) OR  SOP10200.SOPTYPE = 5 or  SOP10200.SOPTYPE = 6)  AND (SOP10200.DROPSHIP <> 1)

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC36042V AS SELECT CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version ,YEAR1, PERIODID,   SUM(Transaction_Amount - SVC_Invoice_Credit_Amoun)   AS Transaction_Amount,   SUM(OrigTransactionAmount - OrigInvCreditAmt)   AS OrigTransactionAmount,  SUM(DSCDLRAM) AS DSCDLRAM, SUM(ORDDLRAT) AS ORDDLRAT,  SUM(Net_Transaction_Amount) AS Net_Transaction_Amount,  SUM(OrigNetTransactionAmount) AS OrigNetTransactionAmount,  SUM(PSTDAMNT) AS PSTDAMNT, SUM(Originating_PostedAmount) AS Originating_PostedAmount,  MAX(DEX_ROW_ID) AS DEX_ROW_ID FROM SVC30604  WHERE (Status = 0) GROUP BY CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version, YEAR1, PERIODID, Status
create view MOPV1900 as  select MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, LOCNCODE,BIN, sum(ATYALLOC) as ATYALLOC  from MOP1900  group by MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, LOCNCODE,BIN

CREATE VIEW dbo.ATP_STK_IN AS  SELECT IV00101.ITEMNMBR,  LOCNCODE =   CASE IV10001.IVDOCTYP  WHEN 1  THEN TRXLOCTN  WHEN 2  THEN TRXLOCTN  WHEN 3  THEN TRNSTLOC  END,  IV10000.DOCDATE AS EXPDATE,  6 AS TABLETYPE,  0 AS SOPTYPE,  IV10001.IVDOCTYP AS DOCTYPE,  IV10001.IVDOCNBR AS DOCNUMBER,  IV10001.LNSEQNBR AS LNITMSEQ,  DBCRID =  CASE IV10001.IVDOCTYP  WHEN 1  THEN 'Adjustment'  WHEN 2  THEN 'Variance'  WHEN 3  THEN 'Transfer'  END,  '   ' AS DBCRNAME,  IV10001.TRXQTY AS QUANTITY,  0 AS BACKORDER,  0 AS ALLOCATED,  IV10001.UOFM,  IV10001.QTYBSUOM,  0 AS BALANCE,  '' AS TYPE  FROM IV00101  INNER JOIN IV10001 ON   IV00101.ITEMNMBR = IV10001.ITEMNMBR  INNER JOIN  IV10000 ON (IV10001.IVDOCNBR = IV10000.IVDOCNBR) AND   (IV10001.IVDOCTYP = IV10000.IVDOCTYP)  WHERE (IV10001.IVDOCTYP = 1 AND IV10001.TRXQTY > 0) OR  (IV10001.IVDOCTYP = 2 AND IV10001.TRXQTY > 0) OR  (IV10001.IVDOCTYP = 3 AND IV10001.TRXQTY > 0 AND IV10001.TRTQTYTY = 1)

CREATE VIEW dbo.SVC36043V AS SELECT CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version ,YEAR1, PERIODID,   SUM(Transaction_Amount - SVC_Invoice_Credit_Amoun)   AS Transaction_Amount,   SUM(OrigTransactionAmount - OrigInvCreditAmt)   AS OrigTransactionAmount,  SUM(DSCDLRAM) AS DSCDLRAM, SUM(ORDDLRAT) AS ORDDLRAT,  SUM(Net_Transaction_Amount) AS Net_Transaction_Amount,  SUM(OrigNetTransactionAmount) AS OrigNetTransactionAmount,  SUM(PSTDAMNT) AS PSTDAMNT, SUM(Originating_PostedAmount) AS Originating_PostedAmount,  MAX(DEX_ROW_ID) AS DEX_ROW_ID FROM SVC30604  WHERE (Status = 1) GROUP BY CONTNBR, CONSTS, SVC_Contract_Version, YEAR1, PERIODID, Status

create view MOPV1910   as  select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.PICKLISTSEQ,SUM(TRXQTY) as TRXQTY, a.PICKNUMBER, a.PICKDOCLINENUM, '' as LOCNCODE from   MOP1210 a, MOP1200 b where  a.PICKNUMBER = b.PICKNUMBER and   a.TRX_TYPE = 6 and b.POSTED = 0 group by a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.PICKLISTSEQ,a.PICKNUMBER, a.PICKDOCLINENUM

CREATE VIEW dbo.ATP_STK_OUT AS  SELECT IV00101.ITEMNMBR,  IV10001.TRXLOCTN AS LOCNCODE,  IV10000.DOCDATE AS EXPDATE,  3 AS TABLETYPE,  0 AS SOPTYPE,  IV10001.IVDOCTYP AS DOCTYPE,  IV10001.IVDOCNBR AS DOCNUMBER,  IV10001.LNSEQNBR AS LNITMSEQ,  DBCRID =  CASE IV10001.IVDOCTYP  WHEN 1  THEN 'Adjustment'  WHEN 2  THEN 'Variance'  WHEN 3  THEN 'Transfer'  END,  '   ' AS DBCRNAME,  IV10001.TRXQTY AS QUANTITY,  0 AS BACKORDER,  IV10001.TRXQTY AS ALLOCATED,  IV10001.UOFM,  IV10001.QTYBSUOM,  0 AS BALANCE,  '' AS TYPE  FROM IV00101 INNER JOIN IV10001 ON   IV00101.ITEMNMBR = IV10001.ITEMNMBR   INNER JOIN IV10000 ON   (IV10001.IVDOCNBR = IV10000.IVDOCNBR) AND  (IV10001.IVDOCTYP = IV10000.IVDOCTYP)  WHERE (IV10001.IVDOCTYP = 1 AND IV10001.TRXQTY < 0) OR  (IV10001.IVDOCTYP = 2 AND IV10001.TRXQTY < 0) OR  (IV10001.IVDOCTYP = 3 AND IV10001.TRXQTY > 0 AND IV10001.TRFQTYTY = 1)

CREATE VIEW dbo.CM00500 (CHEKBKID, DSCRIPTN, CURNCYID, INACTIVE, CURRBLNC, BANKID, CMUSRDF1, CMUSRDF2,  Last_Reconciled_Balance, Last_Reconciled_Date,CURRNIDX, DEX_ROW_ID)   AS    SELECT CM00100.CHEKBKID, CM00100.DSCRIPTN, CM00100.CURNCYID, CM00100.INACTIVE, CM00100.CURRBLNC,  CM00100.BANKID, CM00100.CMUSRDF1, CM00100.CMUSRDF2, CM00100.Last_Reconciled_Balance, CM00100.Last_Reconciled_Date,  DYNGP16..MC40200.CURRNIDX, CM00100.DEX_ROW_ID   FROM CM00100 LEFT OUTER JOIN DYNGP16..MC40200 ON  ( CM00100.CURNCYID = DYNGP16..MC40200.CURNCYID )

create view SVC600TV as select H.CONTNBR,   H.SVC_Contract_Line_SEQ,   COMPDTE=max(H.COMPDTE),   QTYSOLD=sum(L.QTYSOLD)  from SVC00200 H,   SVC00203 L where H.CALLNBR=L.CALLNBR   and L.LINITMTYP = 'L'   and dateadd(Minute,datepart(Minute,H.COMPTME),dateadd(Hour,datepart(Hour,H.COMPTME),H.COMPDTE)) in   (select max(dateadd(Minute,datepart(Minute,A.COMPTME),dateadd(Hour,datepart(Hour,A.COMPTME),A.COMPDTE)))   from SVC00200 A where A.CONTNBR = H.CONTNBR) group by H.CONTNBR, H.SVC_Contract_Line_SEQ

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[EmployeeTimecardPending] AS  SELECT        TOP (100) PERCENT TH.EMPLOYID, TH.Pay_Schedule, TH.YEAR1, TH.PERIODID, MAX(SD.PERNAME) AS PERNAME, MAX(SD.STRTDATE) AS STRTDATE, MAX(SD.ENDDATE) AS ENDDATE, 0 AS Group_ID,   '' AS LVLLABEL, MAX(E.LASTNAME) AS LASTNAME, MAX(E.FRSTNAME) AS FRSTNAME, MAX(E.MIDLNAME) AS MIDLNAME, MAX(E.EMPLSUFF) AS EMPLSUFF, MAX(ISNULL(S.EMPLOYID, ''))   AS Supervisor_Employee_ID, MAX(E.USERID) AS USERID, MAX(E.SUPERVISORCODE_I) AS SUPERVISORCODE_I, MAX(ISNULL(S.SUPERVISOR, '')) AS SUPERVISOR, MAX(ISNULL(ADD1.PHONE1, '')) AS PHONE1,   MAX(ISNULL(ADD2.PHONE2, '')) AS PHONE2, ISNULL(LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(MAX(SUP.LASTNAME))) + ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(MAX(SUP.FRSTNAME))) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(MAX(SUP.MIDLNAME))), 40), '') AS EMPLNAME,   SUM(TD.UNTSTOPY) AS UNTSTOPY, MAX(SH.PAYPEROD) AS PAYPEROD, 0 AS InfoValue, 0 AS MKTOPROC, MAX(TH.Workflow_Status) AS Workflow_Status, MAX(E.DEPRTMNT) AS DEPRTMNT, MAX(E.JOBTITLE)   AS JOBTITLE, MAX(E.LOCATNID) AS LOCATNID, MAX(E.DIVISIONCODE_I) AS DIVISIONCODE_I, '' AS CMMTTEXT FROM            dbo.UPR10500 AS TH INNER JOIN  dbo.UPR10501 AS TD ON TH.EMPLOYID = TD.EMPLOYID AND TH.Pay_Schedule = TD.Pay_Schedule AND TH.YEAR1 = TD.YEAR1 AND TH.PERIODID = TD.PERIODID INNER JOIN  dbo.UPR42101 AS SD ON SD.Pay_Schedule = TH.Pay_Schedule AND SD.YEAR1 = TH.YEAR1 AND SD.PERIODID = TH.PERIODID INNER JOIN  dbo.UPR42100 AS SH ON SH.Pay_Schedule = SD.Pay_Schedule INNER JOIN  dbo.UPR00100 AS E ON E.EMPLOYID = TH.EMPLOYID LEFT OUTER JOIN  dbo.UPR00102 AS ADD1 ON E.EMPLOYID = ADD1.EMPLOYID AND E.ADRSCODE = ADD1.ADRSCODE LEFT OUTER JOIN  dbo.UPR41700 AS S ON E.SUPERVISORCODE_I = S.SUPERVISORCODE_I LEFT OUTER JOIN  dbo.UPR00100 AS SUP ON S.EMPLOYID = SUP.EMPLOYID LEFT OUTER JOIN  dbo.UPR00102 AS ADD2 ON ADD2.EMPLOYID = S.EMPLOYID AND ADD2.ADRSCODE = SUP.ADRSCODE WHERE        (TH.Workflow_Status = 4) GROUP BY TH.EMPLOYID, TH.Pay_Schedule, TH.YEAR1, TH.PERIODID

        JRNENTRY,
        ORTRXSRC,
        REFRENCE,
        ORDOCNUM,
        ORMSTRID,
        ORMSTRNM,
        DEBITAMT,
        DEBITAMT - CRDTAMNT AS Net,

    FROM GL30000  -- Account Transaction History
    WHERE SOURCDOC NOT IN ('BBF', 'P/L') AND VOIDED = 0

SELECT
    YEAR1 AS Trx_Year,
    TRXDATE AS Trx_Date,
    JRNENTRY AS Journal_Entry,
    ORTRXSRC AS Originating_TRX_Source,
    REFRENCE AS Reference,
    ORMSTRID AS Originating_Master_ID,
    ORMSTRNM AS Originating_Master_Name,
    ORDOCNUM AS Originating_Doc_Number,
    DEBITAMT,
    CRDTAMNT AS Credit_Amount,
    Net AS Net_Amount,
    ACTNUMST AS Account_Number,
    ACTDESCR AS Account_Description,
    ACCATDSC AS Account_Category,
    CURNCYID AS Currency_ID,
    USWHPSTD AS User_Who_Posted
FROM CombinedTransactions AS GL
INNER JOIN GL00105 AS GM ON GL.ACTINDX = GM.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN GL00100 AS GA ON GL.ACTINDX = GA.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN GL00102 AS C ON GA.ACCATNUM = C.ACCATNUM;

MRPPREFS.MRPEITHER_I = 1 then 0  else IV.MNFCTRNGVRBLLDTM  END AS MNFCTRNGVRBLLDTM,  CASE  when IV.REPLENISHMENTMETHOD = 1 then IV.MNMMORDRQTY  when IV.REPLENISHMENTMETHOD = 2 then CREATE   VIEW [tk].[vw_BRTXR]
AS
SELECT dbo.GL00105.ACTNUMST AS 'Account_Number',
       dbo.GL00100.ACTDESCR AS 'Account_Name',
       dbo.CM00100.CHEKBKID AS 'Checkbook_ID',
       dbo.CM00100.CURRBLNC AS 'Current_Bank_Balance',
       dbo.GL20000.JRNENTRY AS 'Journal_Number',
       dbo.GL20000.TRXDATE AS 'Transaction_Date',
       YEAR(dbo.GL20000.TRXDATE) AS 'Transaction_Year',
       MONTH(dbo.GL20000.TRXDATE) AS 'Transaction_Month',
       CASE dbo.GL20000.SERIES
           WHEN 2 THEN dbo.GL20000.REFRENCE
           ELSE dbo.GL20000.ORMSTRNM
       END AS 'Source_Name',
       dbo.GL20000.DEBITAMT AS 'Debit',
       dbo.GL20000.CRDTAMNT AS 'Credit',
       dbo.GL20000.DEBITAMT - dbo.GL20000.CRDTAMNT AS 'Net',
       CASE
           WHEN (dbo.GL20000.DEBITAMT - dbo.GL20000.CRDTAMNT) < 0 THEN 'Decrease'
           ELSE 'Increase'
       END AS Effect,
       CASE dbo.GL20000.SERIES
           WHEN 2 THEN 'Financial'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'Sales'
           WHEN 4 THEN 'Purchasing'
           WHEN 5 THEN 'Inventory'
           WHEN 6 THEN 'Payroll'
           WHEN 7 THEN 'Project'
           ELSE 'Other'
       END AS Series,
       dbo.GL20000.ORPSTDDT AS 'Date_Posted',
       dbo.GL20000.SOURCDOC
FROM dbo.GL20000
INNER JOIN dbo.GL00100 ON dbo.GL20000.ACTINDX = dbo.GL00100.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN dbo.GL00105 ON dbo.GL00100.ACTINDX = dbo.GL00105.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN dbo.CM00100 ON dbo.GL00105.ACTINDX = dbo.CM00100.ACTINDX
WHERE (dbo.GL20000.VOIDED = 0)
  AND (dbo.GL20000.SOURCDOC <> 'BBF')
UNION
SELECT dbo.GL00105.ACTNUMST AS 'Account_Number',
       dbo.GL00100.ACTDESCR AS 'Account_Name',
       dbo.CM00100.CHEKBKID AS 'Checkbook_ID',
       dbo.CM00100.CURRBLNC AS 'Current_Bank_Balance',
       dbo.GL30000.JRNENTRY AS 'Journal_Number',
       dbo.GL30000.TRXDATE AS 'Transaction_Date',
       YEAR(dbo.GL30000.TRXDATE) AS 'Transaction_Year',
       MONTH(dbo.GL30000.TRXDATE) AS 'Transaction_Month',
       CASE dbo.GL30000.SERIES
           WHEN 2 THEN dbo.GL30000.REFRENCE
           ELSE dbo.GL30000.ORMSTRNM
       END AS 'Source_Name',
       dbo.GL30000.DEBITAMT AS 'Debit',
       dbo.GL30000.CRDTAMNT AS 'Credit',
       dbo.GL30000.DEBITAMT - dbo.GL30000.CRDTAMNT AS 'Net',
       CASE
           WHEN (dbo.GL30000.DEBITAMT - dbo.GL30000.CRDTAMNT) < 0 THEN 'Decrease'
           ELSE 'Increase'
       END AS Effect,
       CASE dbo.GL30000.SERIES
           WHEN 2 THEN 'Financial'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'Sales'
           WHEN 4 THEN 'Purchasing'
           WHEN 5 THEN 'Inventory'
           WHEN 6 THEN 'Payroll'
           WHEN 7 THEN 'Project'
           ELSE 'Other'
       END AS Series,
       dbo.GL30000.ORPSTDDT AS 'Date_Posted',
       dbo.GL30000.SOURCDOC
FROM dbo.GL30000
INNER JOIN dbo.GL00100 ON dbo.GL30000.ACTINDX = dbo.GL00100.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN dbo.GL00105 ON dbo.GL00100.ACTINDX = dbo.GL00105.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN dbo.CM00100 ON dbo.GL00105.ACTINDX = dbo.CM00100.ACTINDX
WHERE (dbo.GL30000.VOIDED = 0)
  AND (dbo.GL30000.SOURCDOC <> 'BBF')

CREATE VIEW EmploymentHistory AS SELECT TOP 99.99 PERCENT  EMPLOYID AS 'Employee ID', CHANGEREASON_I AS 'Change', STRTDATE AS 'Hire Date',BENADJDATE AS 'Adjusted Hire Date', CASE WHEN  convert(datetime,DEMPINAC) = convert(datetime,0)  THEN  NULL  ELSE DEMPINAC  END   AS 'Date Inactivated', CASE WHEN  convert(datetime,LASTDAYWORKED_I) = convert(datetime,0)  THEN  NULL  ELSE LASTDAYWORKED_I  END AS 'Last Day Worked', CASE WHEN  convert(datetime,TERMINATIONDATE) = convert(datetime,0)  THEN  NULL  ELSE TERMINATIONDATE END AS 'Termination Date' FROM UPR30700  ORDER BY [Employee ID] asc,CHANGEDATE_I desc,TIME1 desc

CREATE VIEW MRPV6002 as   select   MOP.ITEMNMBR,  MOP.MRPTYPE,  MOP.ORDERNUMBER,  0 as ORD,  0 as SOPTYPE,   0 as CMPNTSEQ,  MOP.LOCNCODE,  MOP.RELEASEDATE_I,  MOP.DUEDATE,  MOP.ORGNLRLSDT,  MOP.ORGNLDUEDT,  MOP.MADEBYMORELEASED as SUPPLYQTY,  cast(0 as numeric(19,5)) as DEMANDQTY,  MOP.Status,  MOP.STSDESCR,  IVLOC.BUYERID,  IVLOC.PLANNERID,  cast(isnull(LINKER.JOBNUMBER_I, '') as char(32)) as JOBNUMBER_I ,  case   when (MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_1 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_2 +  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_3 +   MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_4 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_5 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_6 +   MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_7 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_8 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_9 +   MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_10 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_11 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_12 +   MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_13 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_14 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_15 +   MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_16 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_17 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_18 +   MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_19 + MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_20 ) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as MRPHASEXCEPTION,  MOP.MOVEIN,  MOP.MOVEOUT,  MOP.CANCELED,  0 as IsPhantom,  cast('' as char(31)) as PHNTMPRNT,  case  when (select count(MANUFACTUREORDER_I) from IS010001 where IS010001.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = MOP.ORDERNUMBER) > 0 then 1  else 0 end as Linked,  IV.DECPLQTY - 1 as DECPLQTY,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_1,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_2,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_3,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_4,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_5,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_6,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_7,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_8,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_9,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_10,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_11,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_12,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_13,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_14,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_15,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_16,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_17,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_18,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_19,  MOP.HASMRPEXCEPTION_20  from   MRP4010 MOP inner join IV00101 IV on  MOP.ITEMNMBR = IV.ITEMNMBR  inner join MRPV0101 IVLOC on  MOP.ITEMNMBR = IVLOC.ITEMNMBR  AND MOP.LOCNCODE = IVLOC.LOCNCODE  left outer join ICJC1002 LINKER on  MOP.ORDERNUMBER = LINKER.CHILDNUMBER_I  and LINKER.CHILDTYPE_I = 1  and MOP.MRPTYPE = 3 where MADEBYMORELEASED <> 0

CREATE VIEW dbo.PA01100 (CUSTNMBR, PAcontid, PAcontname, PACONTNUMBER, PAContMgrID, PABusMgrID, PASTAT, PASegmentCB, PABBeginDate, PABEndDate, PAProject_Amount, CUSTNAME, DEX_ROW_ID) AS  SELECT PA01101.CUSTNMBR, PA01101.PAcontid, PA01101.PAcontname, PA01101.PACONTNUMBER, PA01101.PAContMgrID, PA01101.PABusMgrID, PA01101.PASTAT, PA01101.PASegmentCB, PA01101.PABBeginDate, PA01101.PABEndDate, PA01101.PAProject_Amount, RM00101.CUSTNAME, PA01101.DEX_ROW_ID FROM PA01101 JOIN RM00101 ON ( PA01101.CUSTNMBR = RM00101.CUSTNMBR )

CREATE VIEW dbo.CFM_SOPAll AS SELECT SOP10100.CUSTNMBR, SOPNUMBE, SOPTYPE, DOCDATE,  CASE WHEN SOP10100.PYMTRMID = ' ' THEN RM00101.PYMTRMID ELSE SOP10100.PYMTRMID END AS PYMTRMID,  CASE WHEN ReqShipDate = '01/01/1900' THEN DOCDATE ELSE ReqShipDate   END  AS DATE,  (-TRDISAMT + FRTAMNT + MISCAMNT + TAXAMNT - PYMTRCVD - DEPRECVD) * CASE WHEN SOPTYPE = 4 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS Amount,  (PYMTRCVD + DEPRECVD) * CASE WHEN SOPTYPE = 4 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS AMNTPAID,  SOP10100.DEX_ROW_ID  FROM SOP10100 INNER JOIN RM00101 ON RM00101.CUSTNMBR = SOP10100.CUSTNMBR WHERE  ((-TRDISAMT + FRTAMNT + MISCAMNT + TAXAMNT - PYMTRCVD - DEPRECVD) <> 0  OR (-TRDISAMT + FRTAMNT + MISCAMNT + TAXAMNT) <> 0)  AND (SOPTYPE >= 2 OR (SOPTYPE = 1 AND DATEDIFF(dd, GetDate(), CASE WHEN  QUOEXPDA = '01/01/1900' THEN GetDate() ELSE QUOEXPDA END ) >= 0)) UNION ALL SELECT SOP10100.CUSTNMBR, SOP10200.SOPNUMBE, SOP10200.SOPTYPE, SOP10100.DOCDATE,  CASE WHEN SOP10100.PYMTRMID = ' ' THEN RM00101.PYMTRMID ELSE SOP10100.PYMTRMID END AS PYMTRMID,  (CASE WHEN SOP10200.ReqShipDate = '01/01/1900' THEN SOP10100.DOCDATE ELSE SOP10200.ReqShipDate  END),  SOP10200.XTNDPRCE * CASE WHEN SOP10200.SOPTYPE = 4 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END,  0, SOP10200.DEX_ROW_ID  FROM SOP10200 INNER JOIN SOP10100 ON SOP10100.SOPNUMBE = SOP10200.SOPNUMBE INNER JOIN  RM00101 ON RM00101.CUSTNMBR = SOP10100.CUSTNMBR WHERE (SOP10200.SOPTYPE >= 2 OR (SOP10200.SOPTYPE = 1 AND DATEDIFF(dd, GetDate(), CASE WHEN  QUOEXPDA = '01/01/1900' THEN GetDate() ELSE QUOEXPDA END ) >= 0))

CREATE VIEW CFM40100 AS SELECT TEMP1.VENDORID, PONUMBER, POSTATUS, DATE as DOCDATE, TEMP1.PYMTRMID, COALESCE(DISGRPER,0) AS DISGRPER,  COALESCE(DUEGRPER,0) AS DUEGRPER, SUM(Amount) as Amount, MAX(TEMP1.DEX_ROW_ID) AS DEX_ROW_ID  FROM   (SELECT POP10100.VENDORID, PONUMBER, POSTATUS, CASE WHEN POP10100.PYMTRMID = ' ' THEN PM00200.PYMTRMID ELSE POP10100.PYMTRMID END AS PYMTRMID,  CASE WHEN REQDATE = '01/01/1900' THEN DOCDATE ELSE REQDATE   END AS DATE,   (-TRDISAMT + FRTAMNT + MSCCHAMT + TAXAMNT) AS Amount, POP10100.DEX_ROW_ID    FROM  POP10100 INNER JOIN  PM00200 ON PM00200.VENDORID = POP10100.VENDORID    WHERE   POSTATUS <> 5 AND POSTATUS <> 6 AND (-TRDISAMT + FRTAMNT + MSCCHAMT + TAXAMNT) <> 0   UNION ALL    SELECT POP10110.VENDORID, POP10110.PONUMBER, POP10100.POSTATUS,    (CASE WHEN POP10100.PYMTRMID = ' ' THEN PM00200.PYMTRMID ELSE POP10100.PYMTRMID END) AS PYMTRMID,    (CASE WHEN POP10110.REQDATE = '01/01/1900' THEN POP10100.DOCDATE ELSE POP10110.REQDATE   END) AS DATE,    (CAST((((QTYORDER - QTYCANCE) * UNITCOST) - (CASE WHEN POP10110.XCHGRATE = 0 THEN OPOSTSUB    WHEN POP10110.RATECALC = 0 THEN OPOSTSUB * POP10110.XCHGRATE ELSE POP10110.OPOSTSUB / POP10110.XCHGRATE    END)) AS MONEY )) AS Amount, POP10110.DEX_ROW_ID    FROM POP10110 INNER JOIN POP10100 ON POP10100.PONUMBER = POP10110.PONUMBER and LineNumber <> 0   INNER JOIN PM00200 ON PM00200.VENDORID = POP10100.VENDORID    WHERE   POLNESTA <> 5  AND POLNESTA <> 6)  AS TEMP1   LEFT JOIN PM00200 ON TEMP1.VENDORID = PM00200.VENDORID   GROUP BY TEMP1.VENDORID, PONUMBER, POSTATUS, DATE, TEMP1.PYMTRMID, COALESCE(DISGRPER,0), COALESCE(DUEGRPER,0)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[CAM10100V] as  SELECT 'Open' as DOCTYPE, RM00401.DOCNUMBR, RM00401.CUSTNMBR, CURTRXAM, ORTRXAMT,RM20101.RMDTYPAL  FROM RM00401   INNER JOIN RM20101   ON RM00401.DOCNUMBR=RM20101.DOCNUMBR AND RM00401.RMDTYPAL=RM20101.RMDTYPAL   WHERE RM00401.DCSTATUS >= 2   AND RM20101.CURTRXAM > 0   AND NOT (RM20101.RMDTYPAL=9 AND RM20101.CURTRXAM = RM20101.ORTRXAMT)  UNION ALL SELECT 'History' as DOCTYPE, DOCNUMBR, CUSTNMBR, CURTRXAM, ORTRXAMT,RM30101.RMDTYPAL  FROM RM30101  WHERE DOCNUMBR in (select APFRDCNM from RM20201 UNION ALL SELECT APTODCNM FROM RM20201)   UNION ALL SELECT 'Open', RMO.DOCNUMBR , RMO.CUSTNMBR, RMO.CURTRXAM, RMO.ORTRXAMT, RMO.RMDTYPAL   FROM RM20101 as RMO  inner join (select APFRDCNM as Doc1, APTODCNM as Doc2 from  RM20201  union all  select APTODCNM, APFRDCNM from  RM20201) as RMA  on RMA.Doc1 = RMO.DOCNUMBR  inner join RM20101 as RMO2  on RMA.Doc2 = RMO2.DOCNUMBR  WHERE RMO.CURTRXAM = 0 and RMO2.CURTRXAM > 0   GROUP BY RMO.DOCNUMBR, RMO.CUSTNMBR, RMO.CURTRXAM, RMO.ORTRXAMT, RMO.RMDTYPAL

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vwGeneralAccount]
 AS
	Select distinct
    CONCAT(rtrim([ACTNUMBR_1]), '-', rtrim([ACTNUMBR_2]), '-', rtrim([ACTNUMBR_3])) as ACCTIDNUM
     , ['Account Summary Master View'].[ACCATNUM]
     , [MNACSGMT]
     , [ACTDESCR]
     , [PSTNGTYP]
     , case
           when [PSTNGTYP] = '0' then
               'Balance Sheet'
           else
               'Profit and Loss'
       END   as PSTYPEdESCR
     , ['Account Category Master'].ACCATDSC
FROM GL11110  AS ['Account Summary Master View']
    INNER JOIN GL00102 AS ['Account Category Master']
        ON ['Account Summary Master View'].ACCATNUM = ['Account Category Master'].ACCATNUM

create view mvarMOStartEndQtys as select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.MANUFACTUREORDERST_I,b.Schedule_Start_QTY, f.DECPLQTY - 1 as DECPLQTY, f.DECPLCUR - 1 as DECPLCUR,a.ENDQTY_I as MOEndQty, a.STARTQTY_I as MOStartQty,  isnull(sum(c.QTYRECVD),0) as RecdEndQty, case  when isnull(sum(c.QTYRECVD),0) = 0 then 0  when b.APPSHRINKTOENDITEM_I = 1 then  round(  isnull(sum(c.QTYRECVD),0)/  (1- (e.SHRINKAGEPERCENT_I/1000.0))  ,DECPLQTY -1)  else  isnull(sum(c.QTYRECVD),0)  end as RecdStartQty, case   when Schedule_Start_QTY = 0 then a.ENDQTY_I  else a.STARTQTY_I end as MORoutingQty, case  when Schedule_Start_QTY = 0 then   isnull(sum(c.QTYRECVD),0)  else  (select case  when isnull(sum(c.QTYRECVD),0) = 0 then 0  when b.APPSHRINKTOENDITEM_I = 1 then  round(  isnull(sum(c.QTYRECVD),0)/  (1- (e.SHRINKAGEPERCENT_I/1000.0))  ,DECPLQTY -1)  else  isnull(sum(c.QTYRECVD),0)   end) end as RecdRoutingQty, isnull(round(sum(c.SETUP_COSTS_TO_USE_I_1 + SETUP_COSTS_TO_BACKFLUSH_1), f.DECPLCUR - 1),0) as SETUPLAB,  isnull(round(sum(c.SETUP_COSTS_TO_USE_I_2 + SETUP_COSTS_TO_BACKFLUSH_2), f.DECPLCUR - 1),0)  as SETUPLABFO,  isnull(round(sum(c.SETUP_COSTS_TO_USE_I_3 + SETUP_COSTS_TO_BACKFLUSH_3), f.DECPLCUR - 1),0)  as SETUPLABVO  from WO010032 a inner join SP010016 b on a.SCHEDULINGPREFEREN_I = b.SCHEDULINGPREFEREN_I and a.MANUFACTUREORDERST_I <> 8  inner join IVR10015 e  on e.ITEMNMBR = a.ITEMNMBR inner join  IV00101 f on f.ITEMNMBR = a.ITEMNMBR  left outer join MOP1100 c on a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = c.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and c.REVERSED_RECEIPT_I=0  group by a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR,a.MANUFACTUREORDERST_I,b.Schedule_Start_QTY,a.ENDQTY_I,a.STARTQTY_I, f.DECPLQTY, e.SHRINKAGEPERCENT_I, b.APPSHRINKTOENDITEM_I, f.DECPLCUR, f.DECPLQTY

create view mvarCalQtyBackflush as  select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.SEQ_I,   0 as BFQTYNONE,  case   when BACKFLUSHITEM_I = 0  then 0  when a.MRPAMOUNT_I -   isnull(c.QTYBF, 0.0)  < 0 then 0  else  a.MRPAMOUNT_I -   isnull(c.QTYBF, 0.0)   end as BFQTYEND,  case   when BACKFLUSHITEM_I = 0  then 0  when (((a.MRPAMOUNT_I - a.FIXED_QTY_I)/j.MOEndQty) * isnull(j.RecdEndQty,0))  + a.FIXED_QTY_I  - isnull(c.QTYBF, 0) < 0 then 0  else  (((a.MRPAMOUNT_I - a.FIXED_QTY_I)/j.MOEndQty) * isnull(j.RecdEndQty,0))  + a.FIXED_QTY_I  - isnull(c.QTYBF, 0)  end as BFQTYRCD   from PK010033 a inner join mvarMOStartEndQtys j on   a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = j.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and j.MANUFACTUREORDERST_I <> 8  and a.MRPAMOUNT_I >= 0  left outer join mvarMOP1000Quauntities d on a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = d.MANUFACTUREORDER_I  and d.PICKLISTSEQ = a.SEQ_I   left outer join mvarMOP1110Quauntities c  on a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = c.MANUFACTUREORDER_I  and c.PICKLISTSEQ = a.SEQ_I

create     view aagMLBudgetViewQTYAndBal as   SELECT 1 AS REPTYPE,   AAG00903.aaBudgetID AS aaBudgetID ,   AAG00903.aaBudget AS aaBudget,   AAG00903.aaBudgetDescr AS aaBudgetDescr,   AAG00903.YEAR1 AS YEAR1,   AAG00902.aaCodeSequence AS aaCodeSequence,   AAG00902.aaLvlCodeString AS aaLvlCodeString,   ISNULL(AAG00904.aaFiscalPeriod, 0) AS aaFiscalPeriod,   AAG00902.aaBudgetTreeID,   ISNULL(AAG00904.Balance,0) AS Balance  FROM  AAG00902 INNER JOIN  AAG00903 ON AAG00902.aaBudgetTreeID = AAG00903.aaBudgetTreeID INNER JOIN  AAG00904 ON AAG00903.aaBudgetID = AAG00904.aaBudgetID AND   AAG00902.aaCodeSequence = AAG00904.aaCodeSequence  Union  SELECT 2 AS REPTYPE,   AAG00903.aaBudgetID AS aaBudgetID ,   AAG00903.aaBudget AS aaBudget,   AAG00903.aaBudgetDescr AS aaBudgetDescr,   AAG00903.YEAR1 AS YEAR1,   AAG00902.aaCodeSequence AS aaCodeSequence,   AAG00902.aaLvlCodeString AS aaLvlCodeString,   ISNULL(AAG00904.aaFiscalPeriod, 0) AS aaFiscalPeriod,   AAG00902.aaBudgetTreeID,   ISNULL(AAG00904.QUANTITY,0) AS Balance  FROM  AAG00902 INNER JOIN  AAG00903 ON AAG00902.aaBudgetTreeID = AAG00903.aaBudgetTreeID INNER JOIN  AAG00904 ON AAG00903.aaBudgetID = AAG00904.aaBudgetID AND   AAG00902.aaCodeSequence = AAG00904.aaCodeSequence

CREATE VIEW [silver].[vwGeneralLedger]
  AS WITH CombinedTransactions AS (
    SELECT
        ACTINDX,
        OPENYEAR AS YEAR1,
        TRXDATE,
        JRNENTRY,
        ORTRXSRC,
        REFRENCE,
        ORDOCNUM,
        ORMSTRID,
        ORMSTRNM,
        DEBITAMT,
        DEBITAMT - CRDTAMNT AS Net,
        CRDTAMNT,
        CURNCYID,
        USWHPSTD
    FROM GL20000  -- Year-to-Date Transaction Open
    WHERE SOURCDOC NOT IN ('BBF', 'P/L') AND VOIDED = 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ACTINDX,
        HSTYEAR AS YEAR1,
        TRXDATE,
        JRNENTRY,
        ORTRXSRC,
        REFRENCE,
        ORDOCNUM,
        ORMSTRID,
        ORMSTRNM,
        DEBITAMT,
        DEBITAMT - CRDTAMNT AS Net,
        CRDTAMNT,
        CURNCYID,
        USWHPSTD
    FROM GL30000  -- Account Transaction History
    WHERE SOURCDOC NOT IN ('BBF', 'P/L') AND VOIDED = 0
)

SELECT
    YEAR1 AS Trx_Year,
    TRXDATE AS Trx_Date,
    JRNENTRY AS Journal_Entry,
    ORTRXSRC AS Originating_TRX_Source,
    REFRENCE AS Reference,
    ORMSTRID AS Originating_Master_ID,
    ORMSTRNM AS Originating_Master_Name,
    ORDOCNUM AS Originating_Doc_Number,
    DEBITAMT,
    CRDTAMNT AS Credit_Amount,
    Net AS Net_Amount,
    ACTNUMST AS Account_Number,
    ACTDESCR AS Account_Description,
    ACCATDSC AS Account_Category,
    CURNCYID AS Currency_ID,
    USWHPSTD AS User_Who_Posted
FROM CombinedTransactions AS GL
INNER JOIN GL00105 AS GM ON GL.ACTINDX = GM.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN GL00100 AS GA ON GL.ACTINDX = GA.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN GL00102 AS C ON GA.ACCATNUM = C.ACCATNUM;

CREATE VIEW silver.vwBankBalance AS
SELECT dbo.GL00105.ACTNUMST AS 'Account_Number',
       dbo.GL00100.ACTDESCR AS 'Account_Name',
       dbo.CM00100.CHEKBKID AS 'Checkbook_ID',
       dbo.CM00100.CURRBLNC AS 'Current_Bank_Balance',
       dbo.GL20000.JRNENTRY AS 'Journal_Number',
       dbo.GL20000.TRXDATE AS 'Transaction_Date',
       YEAR(dbo.GL20000.TRXDATE) AS 'Transaction_Year',
       MONTH(dbo.GL20000.TRXDATE) AS 'Transaction_Month',
       CASE dbo.GL20000.SERIES
           WHEN 2 THEN dbo.GL20000.REFRENCE
           ELSE dbo.GL20000.ORMSTRNM
       END AS 'Source_Name',
       dbo.GL20000.DEBITAMT AS 'Debit',
       dbo.GL20000.CRDTAMNT AS 'Credit',
       dbo.GL20000.DEBITAMT - dbo.GL20000.CRDTAMNT AS 'Net',
       CASE
           WHEN (dbo.GL20000.DEBITAMT - dbo.GL20000.CRDTAMNT) < 0 THEN 'Decrease'
           ELSE 'Increase'
       END AS Effect,
       CASE dbo.GL20000.SERIES
           WHEN 2 THEN 'Financial'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'Sales'
           WHEN 4 THEN 'Purchasing'
           WHEN 5 THEN 'Inventory'
           WHEN 6 THEN 'Payroll'
           WHEN 7 THEN 'Project'
           ELSE 'Other'
       END AS Series,
       dbo.GL20000.ORPSTDDT AS 'Date_Posted',
       dbo.GL20000.SOURCDOC
FROM dbo.GL20000
INNER JOIN dbo.GL00100 ON dbo.GL20000.ACTINDX = dbo.GL00100.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN dbo.GL00105 ON dbo.GL00100.ACTINDX = dbo.GL00105.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN dbo.CM00100 ON dbo.GL00105.ACTINDX = dbo.CM00100.ACTINDX
WHERE (dbo.GL20000.VOIDED = 0)
  AND (dbo.GL20000.SOURCDOC <> 'BBF')
UNION
SELECT dbo.GL00105.ACTNUMST AS 'Account_Number',
       dbo.GL00100.ACTDESCR AS 'Account_Name',
       dbo.CM00100.CHEKBKID AS 'Checkbook_ID',
       dbo.CM00100.CURRBLNC AS 'Current_Bank_Balance',
       dbo.GL30000.JRNENTRY AS 'Journal_Number',
       dbo.GL30000.TRXDATE AS 'Transaction_Date',
       YEAR(dbo.GL30000.TRXDATE) AS 'Transaction_Year',
       MONTH(dbo.GL30000.TRXDATE) AS 'Transaction_Month',
       CASE dbo.GL30000.SERIES
           WHEN 2 THEN dbo.GL30000.REFRENCE
           ELSE dbo.GL30000.ORMSTRNM
       END AS 'Source_Name',
       dbo.GL30000.DEBITAMT AS 'Debit',
       dbo.GL30000.CRDTAMNT AS 'Credit',
       dbo.GL30000.DEBITAMT - dbo.GL30000.CRDTAMNT AS 'Net',
       CASE
           WHEN (dbo.GL30000.DEBITAMT - dbo.GL30000.CRDTAMNT) < 0 THEN 'Decrease'
           ELSE 'Increase'
       END AS Effect,
       CASE dbo.GL30000.SERIES
           WHEN 2 THEN 'Financial'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'Sales'
           WHEN 4 THEN 'Purchasing'
           WHEN 5 THEN 'Inventory'
           WHEN 6 THEN 'Payroll'
           WHEN 7 THEN 'Project'
           ELSE 'Other'
       END AS Series,
       dbo.GL30000.ORPSTDDT AS 'Date_Posted',
       dbo.GL30000.SOURCDOC
FROM dbo.GL30000
INNER JOIN dbo.GL00100 ON dbo.GL30000.ACTINDX = dbo.GL00100.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN dbo.GL00105 ON dbo.GL00100.ACTINDX = dbo.GL00105.ACTINDX
INNER JOIN dbo.CM00100 ON dbo.GL00105.ACTINDX = dbo.CM00100.ACTINDX
WHERE (dbo.GL30000.VOIDED = 0)
  AND (dbo.GL30000.SOURCDOC <> 'BBF')

create view mvarMOSetupCostsCombined as  select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.ITEMNMBR, case  when isnull(b.SETUPLAB, 0) = 0 then 0 else  sum(isnull(b.SETUPLAB, 0) - a.SETUPLAB) end as SETUPLAB, case   when isnull(b.SETUPLABFO, 0) = 0 then 0 else  sum(isnull(b.SETUPLABFO, 0) - a.SETUPLABFO) end as SETUPLABFO,  case  when isnull(b.SETUPLABVO, 0) = 0 then 0 else  sum(isnull(b.SETUPLABVO, 0) - a.SETUPLABVO) end as SETUPLABVO from mvarMOStartEndQtys a left outer join mvarMOSetupCosts b on a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I and a.MANUFACTUREORDERST_I <> 8 group by a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, a.ITEMNMBR, b.SETUPLAB, b.SETUPLABFO, b.SETUPLABVO

CREATE VIEW MFGDI_ALLOCATE_TRANSACTIONS AS  SELECT MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, SUM(TRXQTY) AS TRXQTY, 'ALLOCATE' AS TYPE  FROM MOP1210  WHERE TRX_TYPE = 3  GROUP BY MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ  union  SELECT MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, -1*SUM(TRXQTY) AS TRXQTY, 'UNALLOCATE' AS TYPE  FROM MOP1210  WHERE TRX_TYPE = 4  GROUP BY MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ
