create view mvarBFCostsTotal as  select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,   0 as MatCostNONE,  0 as MatFOCostNONE,   0 as MatVOCostNONE,   0 as LabCostNONE,   0 as LabFOCostNONE,   0 as LabVOCostNONE,   0 as MachCostNONE,   0 as MachFOCostNONE,  0 as MachVOCostNONE,  isnull(b.MatCostEND, 0)as MatCostEND,  isnull(b.MatFOCostEND, 0)as MatFOCostEND,  isnull(b.MatVOCostEND, 0)as MatVOCostEND,  isnull(b.LabCostEND, 0)  + isnull(c.LabCost, 0) as LabCostEND,  isnull(b.LabFOCostEND, 0)   + isnull(c.LabFOCost, 0) as LabFOCostEND,  isnull(b.LabVOCostEND, 0)   + isnull(c.LabVOCost, 0) as LabVOCostEND,  isnull(b.MachCostEND, 0) + isnull(c.MachCost, 0) as MachCostEND,  isnull(b.MachFOCostEND, 0) + isnull(c.MachFOCost, 0)as MachFOCostEND,  isnull(b.MachVOCostEND, 0) + isnull(c.MachVOCost, 0)as MachVOCostEND,  isnull(b.MatCostRCD, 0)as MatCostRCD,  isnull(b.MatFOCostRCD, 0)as MatFOCostRCD,  isnull(b.MatVOCostRCD, 0)as MatVOCostRCD,    0 as LabCostRCD,    0 as LabFOCostRCD,    0 as LabVOCostRCD,   0 as MachCostRCD ,   0 as MachFOCostRCD,   0 as MachVOCostRCD  from mvarMOStartEndQtys a left outer join mvarBFPicklistCost b  on a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = b.MANUFACTUREORDER_I  left outer join mvarBFEstRoutingCosts c on  a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = c.MANUFACTUREORDER_I  where a.MANUFACTUREORDERST_I <> 8
CREATE VIEW MFGDI_ALLOCATE_TRANSACTIONS_SUM AS  SELECT MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, SUM(TRXQTY) AS TRXQTY  FROM MFGDI_ALLOCATE_TRANSACTIONS  GROUP BY MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ

create  VIEW GTM20009V  as  select AAG10003.aaTrxDimID,  AAG10003.aaTrxCodeID,  AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   AAG10001.ACTINDX,   GLPOSTDT,  sum(AAG10002.DEBITAMT - AAG10002.CRDTAMNT) as NETAMNT,   AAG10002.DEX_ROW_ID  from AAG10000  join AAG10001 on AAG10000.aaGLWorkHdrID = AAG10001.aaGLWorkHdrID  join AAG10002 on AAG10001.aaGLWorkHdrID = AAG10002.aaGLWorkHdrID   and AAG10001.aaGLWorkDistID = AAG10002.aaGLWorkDistID  join AAG10003 on AAG10002.aaGLWorkHdrID = AAG10003.aaGLWorkHdrID   and AAG10002.aaGLWorkDistID = AAG10003.aaGLWorkDistID   and AAG10002.aaGLWorkAssignID = AAG10003.aaGLWorkAssignID  join AAG00401 on AAG10003.aaTrxDimID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimID   and AAG10003.aaTrxCodeID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimCodeID where AAG10003.aaTrxCodeID <> 0 group by AAG10003.aaTrxDimID, AAG10003.aaTrxCodeID, AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   AAG10001.ACTINDX, GLPOSTDT, AAG10002.DEX_ROW_ID

create view mvarWIPItemCost as  select MANUFACTUREORDER_I,ITEMNMBR,  QTYRECVD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_1 as WIPInMat,  QTYRECVD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_2 as WIPInMatFO,  QTYRECVD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_3 as WIPInMatVO,  QTYRECVD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_4 as WIPInLab,  QTYRECVD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_5 as WIPInLabFO,  QTYRECVD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_6 as WIPInLabVO,  QTYRECVD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_7 as WIPInMach,  QTYRECVD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_8 as WIPInMachFO,  QTYRECVD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_9 as WIPInMachVO,  QTYRECVD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_10 as WIPInTotal,  QTYSOLD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_1 as WIPOutMat,  QTYSOLD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_2 as WIPOutMatFO,  QTYSOLD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_3 as WIPOutMatVO,  QTYSOLD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_4 as WIPOutLab,  QTYSOLD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_5 as WIPOutLabFO,  QTYSOLD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_6 as WIPOutLabVo,  QTYSOLD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_7 as WIPOutMach,  QTYSOLD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_8 as WIPOutMachFO,  QTYSOLD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_9 as WIPOutMachVO,  QTYSOLD * ITEM_COSTS_ARRAY_I_10 as WIPOutTotal from MOP1000
CREATE VIEW MFGDI_COUNT_ITEMS AS  SELECT MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, COUNT(DISTINCT(ITEMNMBR)) AS COUNTS  FROM MOP1210  GROUP BY MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ

create  VIEW [dbo].[GTM20010V]  as  select AAG30003.aaTrxDimID,  AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID,  AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   sum(AAG30002.DEBITAMT - AAG30002.CRDTAMNT) AS NETAMNT,   AAG30002.DEX_ROW_ID  from AAG30000  join AAG30001 on AAG30000.aaGLHdrID = AAG30001.aaGLHdrID join AAG30002 on AAG30001.aaGLHdrID = AAG30002.aaGLHdrID   and AAG30001.aaGLDistID = AAG30002.aaGLDistID  join AAG30003 on AAG30002.aaGLHdrID = AAG30003.aaGLHdrID   and AAG30002.aaGLDistID = AAG30003.aaGLDistID   and AAG30002.aaGLAssignID = AAG30003.aaGLAssignID  join AAG00401 on AAG30003.aaTrxDimID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimID   and AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimCodeID where ACTINDX in (SELECT ACTINDX FROM GL00100 WHERE PSTNGTYP = 1)   and AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID <> 0  and AAG30001.SOURCDOC <> 'BBF'  and AAG30001.SOURCDOC <> 'P/L' group by AAG30003.aaTrxDimID, AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID, AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   AAG30002.DEX_ROW_ID UNION ALL select AAG40003.aaTrxDimID,  AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID,  AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   sum(AAG40002.DEBITAMT - AAG40002.CRDTAMNT) AS NETAMNT,   AAG40002.DEX_ROW_ID  from AAG40000  join AAG40001 on AAG40000.aaGLHdrID = AAG40001.aaGLHdrID join AAG40002 on AAG40001.aaGLHdrID = AAG40002.aaGLHdrID   and AAG40001.aaGLDistID = AAG40002.aaGLDistID  join AAG40003 on AAG40002.aaGLHdrID = AAG40003.aaGLHdrID   and AAG40002.aaGLDistID = AAG40003.aaGLDistID   and AAG40002.aaGLAssignID = AAG40003.aaGLAssignID  join AAG00401 on AAG40003.aaTrxDimID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimID   and AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimCodeID where ACTINDX in (SELECT ACTINDX FROM GL00100 WHERE PSTNGTYP = 1)   and AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID <> 0   and AAG40001.SOURCDOC <> 'BBF'  and AAG40001.SOURCDOC <> 'P/L' group by AAG40003.aaTrxDimID, AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID, AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   AAG40002.DEX_ROW_ID

create view mvarWIPItemCostSum as  select MANUFACTUREORDER_I,ITEMNMBR,  sum(WIPInMat) as WIPInMat,  sum(WIPInMatFO) as WIPInMatFO,  sum(WIPInMatVO) as WIPInMatVO,  sum(WIPInLab) as WIPInLab,  sum(WIPInLabFO) as WIPInLabFO,  sum(WIPInLabVO) as WIPInLabVO,  sum(WIPInMach) as WIPInMach,  sum(WIPInMachFO) as WIPInMachFO,  sum(WIPInMachVO) as WIPInMachVO,  sum(WIPInTotal) as WIPInTotal,  sum(WIPOutMat) as WIPOutMat,  sum(WIPOutMatFO) as WIPOutMatFO,  sum(WIPOutMatVO) as WIPOutMatVO,  sum(WIPOutLab) as WIPOutLab,  sum(WIPOutLabFO) as WIPOutLabFO,  sum(WIPOutLabVo) as WIPOutLabVo,  sum(WIPOutMach) as WIPOutMach,  sum(WIPOutMachFO) as WIPOutMachFO,  sum(WIPOutMachVO) as WIPOutMachVO,  sum(WIPOutTotal) as WIPOutTotal from mvarWIPItemCost group by MANUFACTUREORDER_I,ITEMNMBR
CREATE VIEW MFGDI_ISSUE_TRANSACTIONS AS  SELECT MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ, SUM(TRXQTY - ATYALLOC) AS TRXQTY  FROM MOP1210  WHERE TRX_TYPE = 1  GROUP BY MANUFACTUREORDER_I, PICKLISTSEQ

create  VIEW [dbo].[GTM20011V]  as  select AAG30003.aaTrxDimID,  AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID,  AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   GLPOSTDT,  sum(AAG30002.DEBITAMT - AAG30002.CRDTAMNT) AS NETAMNT,   AAG30002.DEX_ROW_ID  from AAG30000  join AAG30001 on AAG30000.aaGLHdrID = AAG30001.aaGLHdrID join AAG30002 on AAG30001.aaGLHdrID = AAG30002.aaGLHdrID   and AAG30001.aaGLDistID = AAG30002.aaGLDistID  join AAG30003 on AAG30002.aaGLHdrID = AAG30003.aaGLHdrID   and AAG30002.aaGLDistID = AAG30003.aaGLDistID   and AAG30002.aaGLAssignID = AAG30003.aaGLAssignID  join AAG00401 on AAG30003.aaTrxDimID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimID   and AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimCodeID where AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID <> 0  and AAG30001.SOURCDOC <> 'BBF'  and AAG30001.SOURCDOC <> 'P/L' group by AAG30003.aaTrxDimID, AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID, AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   GLPOSTDT, AAG30002.DEX_ROW_ID UNION ALL select AAG40003.aaTrxDimID,  AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID,  AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   GLPOSTDT,  sum(AAG40002.DEBITAMT - AAG40002.CRDTAMNT) AS NETAMNT,   AAG40002.DEX_ROW_ID  from AAG40000  join AAG40001 on AAG40000.aaGLHdrID = AAG40001.aaGLHdrID join AAG40002 on AAG40001.aaGLHdrID = AAG40002.aaGLHdrID   and AAG40001.aaGLDistID = AAG40002.aaGLDistID  join AAG40003 on AAG40002.aaGLHdrID = AAG40003.aaGLHdrID   and AAG40002.aaGLDistID = AAG40003.aaGLDistID   and AAG40002.aaGLAssignID = AAG40003.aaGLAssignID  join AAG00401 on AAG40003.aaTrxDimID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimID   and AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimCodeID where AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID <> 0   and AAG40001.SOURCDOC <> 'BBF'  and AAG40001.SOURCDOC <> 'P/L' group by AAG40003.aaTrxDimID, AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID, AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   GLPOSTDT, AAG40002.DEX_ROW_ID

create view mvarPicklistMatCost as  select a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR,   sum(a.MRPAMOUNT_I) as MRPAMOUNT_I,  sum(a.MRPAMOUNT_I2) as MRPAMOUNT_I2, a.DECPLQTY,a.DECPLCUR,  sum(MatCost) as MatCost,  sum(MatFOCost) as MatFOCost,  sum(MatVOCost) as MatVOCost,  sum(LabCost) as LabCost,  sum(LabFOCost) as LabFOCost,  sum(LabVOCost) as LabVOCost,  sum(MachCost) as MachCost,  sum(MachFOCost) as MachFOCost,  sum(MachVOCost) as MachVOCost,  sum(MatCostRecd) as MatCostRecd,  sum(MatFOCostRecd) as MatFOCostRecd,  sum(MatVOCostRecd) as MatVOCostRecd,  sum(LabCostRecd) as  LabCostRecd,  sum(LabFOCostRecd) as LabFOCostRecd,  sum(LabVOCostRecd) as LabVOCostRecd,  sum(MachCostRecd) as MachCostRecd,  sum(MachFOCostRecd) as MachFOCostRecd,  sum(MachVOCostRecd) as MachVOCostRecd from mvarPicklistSeqCost a group by a.MANUFACTUREORDER_I,a.ITEMNMBR, a.DECPLQTY,a.DECPLCUR

CREATE VIEW MFGDI_JOIN_TRANSACTIONS AS  SELECT MFGDI_ISSUE_TRANSACTIONS.MANUFACTUREORDER_I, MFGDI_ISSUE_TRANSACTIONS.PICKLISTSEQ,   MFGDI_ISSUE_TRANSACTIONS.TRXQTY AS ISSUES, MFGDI_ALLOCATE_TRANSACTIONS_SUM.TRXQTY AS ALLOCATIONS  FROM MFGDI_ISSUE_TRANSACTIONS, MFGDI_ALLOCATE_TRANSACTIONS_SUM  WHERE MFGDI_ISSUE_TRANSACTIONS.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = MFGDI_ALLOCATE_TRANSACTIONS_SUM.MANUFACTUREORDER_I  AND MFGDI_ISSUE_TRANSACTIONS.PICKLISTSEQ = MFGDI_ALLOCATE_TRANSACTIONS_SUM.PICKLISTSEQ

create  VIEW [dbo].[GTM20012V]  as  select AAG30003.aaTrxDimID,  AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID,  AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   AAG30001.ACTINDX,  GLPOSTDT,  sum(AAG30002.DEBITAMT - AAG30002.CRDTAMNT) AS NETAMNT,   AAG30002.DEX_ROW_ID  from AAG30000  join AAG30001 on AAG30000.aaGLHdrID = AAG30001.aaGLHdrID join AAG30002 on AAG30001.aaGLHdrID = AAG30002.aaGLHdrID   and AAG30001.aaGLDistID = AAG30002.aaGLDistID  join AAG30003 on AAG30002.aaGLHdrID = AAG30003.aaGLHdrID   and AAG30002.aaGLDistID = AAG30003.aaGLDistID   and AAG30002.aaGLAssignID = AAG30003.aaGLAssignID  join AAG00401 on AAG30003.aaTrxDimID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimID   and AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimCodeID where AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID <> 0  and AAG30001.SOURCDOC <> 'BBF'  and AAG30001.SOURCDOC <> 'P/L' group by AAG30003.aaTrxDimID, AAG30003.aaTrxCodeID, AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   AAG30001.ACTINDX, GLPOSTDT, AAG30002.DEX_ROW_ID UNION ALL select AAG40003.aaTrxDimID,  AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID,  AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   AAG40001.ACTINDX,  GLPOSTDT,  sum(AAG40002.DEBITAMT - AAG40002.CRDTAMNT) AS NETAMNT,   AAG40002.DEX_ROW_ID  from AAG40000  join AAG40001 on AAG40000.aaGLHdrID = AAG40001.aaGLHdrID join AAG40002 on AAG40001.aaGLHdrID = AAG40002.aaGLHdrID   and AAG40001.aaGLDistID = AAG40002.aaGLDistID  join AAG40003 on AAG40002.aaGLHdrID = AAG40003.aaGLHdrID   and AAG40002.aaGLDistID = AAG40003.aaGLDistID   and AAG40002.aaGLAssignID = AAG40003.aaGLAssignID  join AAG00401 on AAG40003.aaTrxDimID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimID   and AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID = AAG00401.aaTrxDimCodeID where AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID <> 0   and AAG40001.SOURCDOC <> 'BBF'  and AAG40001.SOURCDOC <> 'P/L' group by AAG40003.aaTrxDimID, AAG40003.aaTrxCodeID, AAG00401.aaTrxDimCode,   AAG40001.ACTINDX, GLPOSTDT, AAG40002.DEX_ROW_ID

CREATE VIEW MFGDI_JR_MOPALLOCATIONS AS  SELECT MFGDI_ALLOCATE_SUMS2.ITEMNMBR, MFGDI_ALLOCATE_SUMS2.LOCNCODE,   SUM(MFGDI_ALLOCATE_SUMS2.ATYALLOC) AS ATYALLOC, IV00102.QTYONHND   FROM MFGDI_ALLOCATE_SUMS2, WO010032, IV00102  WHERE MFGDI_ALLOCATE_SUMS2.MANUFACTUREORDER_I = WO010032.MANUFACTUREORDER_I  AND MFGDI_ALLOCATE_SUMS2.ITEMNMBR = IV00102.ITEMNMBR  AND MFGDI_ALLOCATE_SUMS2.LOCNCODE = IV00102.LOCNCODE  AND MANUFACTUREORDERST_I <> 8  AND IV00102.QTYONHND > 0  AND MFGDI_ALLOCATE_SUMS2.ATYALLOC > IV00102.QTYONHND  GROUP BY MFGDI_ALLOCATE_SUMS2.ITEMNMBR, MFGDI_ALLOCATE_SUMS2.LOCNCODE, IV00102.QTYONHND

CREATE VIEW MFGDI_MOPACTIVITY_ISSUE_PICKDOCS AS  SELECT * FROM MOP10213 WHERE MO_ACTIVITY_REASON_I = 34
